tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bod kyi brda yi bstan bcos mkhas mang dgongs pa'i bcud bsdus gsung rab kun la lta ba'i legs bshad mig dbang rab gsal snang ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /dge legs 'phel// rgya gar skad du/ asmā kam̐ sha ra ṇa nā thaḥgu rūt+ta ma tsa mu nin+d+ra ye na na maḥ bod skad du/ bdag cag rnams kyi skyabs dang mgon bla ma mchog dang thub dbang rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grangs med bskal ba'i sngon du byang chub mchog brnyes kyang / /gdul bya'i snang ngor mdzad pa bcu gnyis zlos gar mkhan/ /'o skol ston pa shākya'i rgyal po zas gtsang sras/ /lha bcas 'gro ba'i dus gsum skyabs mchog gang de rgyal/ /de gsung lung dang rtogs pa dam pa'i chos/ /mdo sngags rig gnas kyis bsdus bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /'gro ba'i sems kyi dri ma 'khrud byed pa'i/ /thar 'dod yongs kyi lam mchog bsngags par 'os/ /nyan rang theg chen sngags kyi sgor zhugs nas/ /rang rang skal bas thob pa'i spangs rtogs kyi/ /yon tan mthar phyin 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /bsod nams zhing gi mchog rnams spyi bos mchod/ /bstan pa'i rtsa ba rgya bod yi ge'i srol/ /dang por 'byed dang bar du dag byed mkhan/ /rim par byon pa'i skyes chen bgrang yas la/ /bka' drin dran pas lan brgyar phyag bgyi'o/ /khyad par zur phud lnga pa gdul bya'i ngor/ /bsam bzhin byon pa thon mi sam+bho ṭa/ /zhes grags 'gro ba'i mig gcig bod yul gyi/ /chos kyi sgron ma'i rtsa ba khyod kyis skyongs/ /gzhan yang rigs gsum rnam 'phrul sa skya pa'i/ /bla chen yab sras chos rje khu dbon bcas/ /de dag srol 'dzin yongs dang 'gran bral mchog /sngags 'chang bstan pa'i nyi mas bdag la srungs/ /de sras pad+ma'i rnam 'phrul dbang po'i mtshan/ /'gro mgon chos rje slar byon grags pa'i zhabs/ /rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs mus pa chen po sogs/ /skyabs gnas bslu med rnams la gus btud nas/

/bod kyi brda yi bstan bcos mkhas mang gis/ /zab yangs dgongs pa'i gnad don bcud bsdus pa'i/ /gsung rab kun la lta ba'i legs bshad gtam/ /mig dbang rab gsal snang ba 'dir spel lo/ /zhes mchod par brjod cing bshad par dam bcas nas/ 'dir bod kyi brda'i bstan bcos mkhas mang dgongs pa'i bcud bsdus gsung rab kun la lta ba'i legs bshad mig dbang rab gsal snang ba zhes bya ba 'di 'chad pa la spyi don rnam pa gsum ste/ bod kyi yi ge byung tshul dang / de'i rnam gzhag ston pa'i gsung rab ji ltar dar ba'i tshul/ skabs su bab pa 'dir bstan gyi bstan bcos dngos bshad pa/ de ltar bshad pa'i dge ba byang chub tu bsngo ba'o/ /dang po ni snyigs dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa zha lu lo chen chos skyong bzang pos mdzad pa'i bod kyi brda'i bstan bcos legs par bshad pa rin po che'i za ma tog bkod pa'i sbyar byang tshigs bcad ma las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ ji skad du/ bod yul dbus kyi rgyal po mchog /gnam ri srong btsan yan chad la/ /bod la yi ge med ces grag /chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i dus/ /mkhan po thon mi sam+bho ṭas/ /lāñtsha'i kha che'i yi ge la dpe mdzad nas lha sa'i sku mkhar ma ru bya bar rje blon mtshams bcad nas brtsams grag yi ge dper mdzad nas/ /dbyangs yig i u e o bzhi/ /gsal byed ka sogs sum cu mdzad/ /de las rjes su 'jug pa bcu/ /de las kyang ni sngon 'jug lnga/ /ra la sa yi mgo gsum dang / /ya ra la yi smad 'dogs gsum/ /da dang sa yi yang 'jug sogs/ /ston pa'i bstan bcos rnam brgyad ces grags na'ang bstan pa 'phel 'grib kyi dbang gis deng sang sum cu pa dang rtags 'jug las mi snang ngo / /mdzad/ /bka' srol de nyid la brten nas/ /lo paṇa skyes mchog du ma yis/ /rgya gar rgya nag kha che dang / /li dang bal po'i yul sogs nas/ /thub pa'i gsung rab sna tshogs bsgyur/

/brda' yang mi 'dra sna tshogs 'gyur/ /chos rgyal ral pa can gyi dus/ /ska cog zhang sogs mkhas mang gis/ /rgyal po'i bkas bskul gsar bcad kyi/ /skad kyi brda sbyar gtan la phab/ /slad nas rin chen bzang po dang / /blo ldan shes rab la sogs pa/ /mkhas mchog rnams kyang de la brten/ /kho bos mkhan po thon mi'i gzhung / /sum cu pa dang rtags 'jug 'di gnyis la ṭī kā re byas yod cing / 'dir yang de dag dpang du byas nas bshad pas so/ /gi /don yang legs par gtan la phab/ /ska cog rin chen bzang po dang / /blo ldan shes rab shong dpang sogs/ /mkhas mang legs bshad bcud myangs te/ /'phags yul skad dang gangs can gyi/ /gsung rab brda la 'dris pa'i blos/ /don 'di legs par bkod pa nyid/ /gang zhig gsung rab rnams kyi don/ /gtan la 'bebs na smos ci 'tshal/ /'jig rten phal pa'i rnam gzhag cig /byed kyang tshig gi sbyor ba gces/ /'di ni mkhas rmongs 'byed pa ste/ /don 'di khong du chud pa'i mi/ /mang po 'dus pa'i nang dag tu/ /mkhas pa'i stan la 'dug par dbang / /zhes dang / legs sbyar brda sprod ka lā tsan+d+ra pa ṇi ni/ /sā dhu kīrti rab 'byor zla ba drag 'byor dang / /bgrod dka' seng ge chos 'phags 'chi med seng ge sogs/ /shong dpang brgyud pa'i bla mas legs bshad gang yin dang / /bod kyi mkhan po thon mi'i sum rtags bstan bcos dang / /ska cog sogs kyi gsar bcad sgra sbyor bam gnyis dang / /dag byed mkhan po'i snye thang pa grags seng ge gaṅgā bdud rtsi'i rtsa nag phug pa thugs rje seng ge'i/ chu rgyun dang / /'od zer stag ston gzhon dpal gyi/ brgya pa sgra don bu ston seng ge 'od kyi/ rgya mtsho'i me long dang / /smra ba'i rje byams pa gling pa'i/ rgyan dang 'khrul pa bsam sding pa kun bsam gyi/ spong ba la sogs pa'i/ /legs bshad snying po gces so 'tshal rnams 'dir bsdus te/

/yi ger 'bri dang smra dang 'chad dang rtsom pa sogs/ /kun la phan phyir rnam dkar bsam pas 'di brtsams so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi tshig don rnams la zhib tu dpyad de khong du chud par bya zhing / kho bos 'chad par 'gyur ba'i bstan bcos 'di ni sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang / sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po yab sras rnams kyis thugs rtsis su mdzad pa'i zha lu lo chen nyid kyi gsung rab za ma tog gi dgongs pa gtso bor bkod pa la der ma 'dus pa'i kha skong 'os pa rnams tshad ldan gyi mkhas pa gzhan gyi legs bshad las kyang btus te sngon byon gyi mkhas pa mang po'i dgongs pa'i bcud bsdus kyi lugs su bshad pa yin pas de bzhin du rtogs par byos shig spyi don gnyis pa skabs su bab pa'i 'dir bstan gyi bstan bcos dngos bshad pa la gsum ste/ sngon 'jug sogs yi ge'i sbyor ba rgyas par bshad pa/ rnam dbye phrad sogs gces pa sna tshogs thun mong du bshad pa/ yi ge'i sbyor ba la 'khrul pa spong ba bshad pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ brjod don kā li sum cu la/ /rkyang pa 'phul dang mgo can dang / /dbyangs lnga ya ra la wa'i 'dogs/ /rjes 'jug dpe sogs rim bzhin bshad/ dper na ka yig la sngon 'jug mgo gsum med pa/ dbyangs yig lnga ya ra la wa dang rjes 'jug gis phye ba'i brda ste/ /kun mkhyen shākya ka ya wak+ka tsit+ta sogs/ dang / /ka tan ka ra ka shi ka /nags klung chu klung na dī/ dba' klong klu/ / nā ga ka dag klong yangs klong du dbang du gyur pa/ gyur/ /ka ku bha ya karma 'phrin las pa/ pa/ /ka sha ku sha ka ma la/ /kan+da ku mud keng shu ka /ka ra wī ra ke ta ka /shing kun a krong dar ya kan/ /ka ped ku ba kim+pa'i 'bras/ /kaṇ+ḍa kā ri g.ya' kyi ma/ /nā ri ke la ka ko la/ /ke la sha dang ka liṅga/ /kau sham bhi dang ko sa la/ /kau shi mkhas pa sogs mang po la 'jug go

/ka ka ma ta/ /ka t+yā ya na kauṇ+ḍi/ /ko krad kong yul ke'u tshang / /'di ka rkyang yin pa'i shes byed la kha cig na re/ yungs kar nag po yod pa'i phyir zer yang ma nges te/ spyi'i sgra bshad bye brag la tshang mi dgos pa'i phyir dkar yol dang mtsho skyes bzhin no/ /'on kyang brda rnying dag pa rnams na ka rkyang nyid du yod cing 'dod rgyal ba'o zhes smra rgyan las bshad do/ / yungs sar+ṣa pa/ kar ka ru thod le kor/ /ku shu gur kum ka cha kun/ / kun kyang la brungs kyang zer/ sarba/ bsags kyang 'thab krol phung don med/ krol rgyu/ /kye ma ma la/ kye ha ha ba/ hud kye hwa kwa/ / bho/ kye he bho/ kye kong kong kyong kyong du/ /krog krog krab krab mgo kyog kyog /krong krong kog gis ker langs nas/ /ku res do ker thor cog can/ ko sko 'degs/ /ku co kyal ka klan ka'i rgyud/ /'on u tā no/ kyang lan kha khyer ram stegs bu'am pu shu/ kan nyen kor than kor yang zer/ du/ /ka lan ta ka ke'u kun dngos/ /ka la piṅga'i kyur kyur skad/ /rus krang krang nge kag gi kang / /stod kor klad don klad klad ces pa gong ste/ kor dang / /ke sha zhabs kyu lcags kyus btab/ /kar kar zug langs bad kan chu'i/ /ku dri chu'i/ ya kan 'og rtsa kyal kyal/ /'byams klas mtha' par+yan+ta/ kla klog pa tha taṃ/ kyang klag /ston ka dpyid ka gnyis ka'i dus/ /glang chen thal kar ber kas brdungs/ /ka lā pa yi kla klo m+le ts+tsha/ bcom/ /ka ba ka tsa lin+das klubs/ / kyon pa'am phub pa/ kar+ṣa pa ni ke ke ru/ /kang ka 'di ko klag ca co/ cor che/ /keng rus ka li'i klad masta ka pa zad/ /kun nas kun tu par kob kob/ /ku hu'i mgrin sogs ka rkyang ngo / /bkra shis maṅgalaṃ/ bkrag mdangs tshon bkra tsi tra/ bkram/ / a ba kī r+ṇa/

bka' ā dzñā/ bsgos khal bkal srad bu bkal/ /pho nya bkye sogs 'gre/ ston mo 'od spul bkye/ / tsod ti/ dgongs pa bkral sogs/ khral bkral dgongs bcings bkrol/ muk+ta/ /dri ma bkru bkrus sik+ta/ bkren kṛ pa ṇa/ zhing k+ṣu dha/ bkres/ / bu ma tsha zer/ /bkar nas bkyigs ban+dhi ta/ te srog bkum bkrongs/ mā ri ti/ /bkad za ma tog las 'du ba'i gnas tshul bshad la/ li shi'i gur khang las 'du khang ngam 'dug sar bshad/ sar smra rgyan las gral lo gsungs/ snod bkang thugs dam bkang / /bsnyen bkur mchod pa'i rnam grangs/ bkur sat+kā ra/ stis gong du bkur/ /bkod legs bder n+yā sa/ bkod zur bkol snod spyad bkol dang g.yog tu bkol sogs/ dang / /shing bkug ā kṛṣ+ṭa/ bkas shing g.yog tu bkol/ /gnang 'gro ba bkag sogs/ bkag ṣe dha/ sman bku bkus pū ti muk+taṃ/ te khu ba bton pa'i sman/ bor/ /gos bkab ts+tshan+na/ gzhu bkang rtsa ba bkog /bka' drin bkar khrims bsgrags pa/ btags bka' blo bde/ /bka' bkyon brgyad bkag 'khor du bkon/ pa khro ba/ lam bka' spa bkong rgyal pos bkrabs/ mang po'i nang nas 'dams pa/ /lus bkan lag bkan bkros nas bkri/ drang ba'am khrid pa/ ā ne ya/ mdo bklags bsgrags tshar ba'i don/ pa thi ta/ /mgo bkad thags kyi bkad/ /bkyal 'brel med du smra ba/ 'di la sngon 'jug mi byed pa yod de kyal ka la dpags pa'i blo gzo yin ces smra rgyan las/ za ma tog las ka rkyang bshad do/ /pa'i ngag sogs bas 'phul ka'o/ thog yig /dkar chag ma dkrug dkor dang ka cha nor gyi spyi ming / dkor mdzod ka ṣa/ dkrogs/ /dkyil 'khor maṇ+ḍal/ dkyil maṇ+ḍa/ gyi dkrongs bskyed dka'/ /dka' krits+tsh+ra/

dka' tshegs/ ta pa/ thub dka' spyad dkon mchog rat+na/ dkon/ /mdog dkar si ta/ dkyel khong yangs pa/ che spyan dkyus ā ya ta/ ring / /dkyus ma'i dkor zas dri ma dku/ dri mi zhim pa'i dri tsha ba/ pū taṃ/ /dkos nyam thag thag kun nyon mongs kyi ming / dkris/ gos kyis dkris/ /dku kuk+ṣi/ skabs dku zlum dku ma rnyongs/ /sprin dkrigs zho dkrogs rol gyim shing yang zer/ mo dkrol/ /dkar yol chag dkrum dkyus rgyug par/ par dkyus/ mgyogs pa'i rgyug pa/ /dka' 'grel dkris phrag dkan rkan zhes pa'ang 'thad/ gzar po/ /phan tshun dkrugs gong 'og go rim sogs/ sogs das 'phul ka'o/ /rkang lag rka zhing dkan zhes pa'ang yod/ rkan kha nang gi dang rkub/ / bā yu/ chom rkun tsau ra/ rkyan dang snod spyad/ phye rkyam rku/ / rku ma/ rkang pa pā da/ chig rkyang sa khan ti/ rko rko bar byed pa'i don la/ rkos/ / rkos mkhan la kha na ka tshud mo mkhan yang zer/ gan rkyal rked rkyong rkon pa 'dzugs/ /rka mgo'i rkyal rtsed ri dwags rkyang / /rgyu pra t+ye ya/ rkyen la sogs ra btags ka'o/ /lkog pa ro k+ṣa/ gyur lkog ma lkog ba glang gi lkog ma'i lpags pa 'phyang ba la zer/ shal dang / /ngag lkugs mū ka la sogs lar btags ka'o/ /ska cog skal ldan skar ma tā rā/ a sh+la ṣā skag /sku skem snum le pa na/ skud skud sū tra/ pa skyol/ /skyo phra ma la'ang 'jug ma'i skyag pa skyung bha ka ba tī/ kas skyud/ /ska rags ma kha la/ skyer ha ri da/ skya paṇ+ḍa ra/ skyu ru am+la/ ra/ /skyes bu skyes kyi skom gyur am+la/ skol/ /gos skon skyen yang skur a pa bā da/ pas skyo/ /skem byed skol byed skor ba pra dak+ṣi ṇa/

byed/ /skyu tshod ma/ rum skyu gang skyug uṅgīr+ṇa/ pas skyang / /skran dang skyigs i gu grong tshig bu skya rbab skrangs/ /ri skegs chu ka da mā/ chu bya/ skyar skya ga'i skad/ /skun bu skam pa skya ba skyogs/ /dge skos bro skrab ḍa ru skrog /skud po skyong 'khrug pa/ ngogs snyan phra ma/ skyos skrag /rgya skyegs skyed ut+pā/ tshal skyer ha ri tra/ pa'i skas/ /ske dang og skor chu skyeg skyes/ ut+pan+na/ /skyi g.ya'i skyon skyab skyabs 'gro sha ra ṇa ga ma na/ skyar/ / skyor la/ /'tsho skyong ā shā pū ra/ re skong skyin da byed kyi ming / gor skogs/ /srab skyogs skyes bzang rgyal gyi skugs/ / rgyal 'gugs pa'i/ gla ha/ /bya prā g+bhā ra/ skyibs skar khol ma'am ba glang mig lta bu/ khung skor tsher skyid/ /skyel ma skyas chen skyos las skrod/ /chu skyom zho skrog rtsis kyi skyeg /ji skad 'di skad kha skong skabs/ /sa skyor skyang skong byug pa'ang zer zhal ba dang zhal zhal/ nul skam re skan/ /skad cig skra ka ca/ skye shing skrus pa/ /sbas skung mtha' skor skabs su chud/ /rang skal skye mched thugs dam skong / /bya bya rgya/ skon skyi dkar skye tshe'i 'bru/ /skyo ma snga btsan skyil krung la smra rgyan las das 'phul bshad kyang zha lu lo chen gyi dgongs pa 'di rang yin/ krung skyod/ /skye rengs la sogs sar btags ka'o/ /'dod pa brkam pas 'dod zhen che ba'am brkam chag che ba zer/ brku 'di bya ba dang 'brel bas bas 'phul yod/ bya brkus/ /sra ka ṭhi nāsta ra/ brkyang lag brkyang brko bya bya ba dang 'brel/ brkos/ /bas 'phul ra mgo ldan ka'o/ /byug pa bsku le pa/ bsku'i lap+ta/ lag bskum kuñtsi ta/ bskum/ /'phrin bskur ba sogs 'gro/

dbang bskur pre ṣi ta/ chos la tso da na/ bskul/ /nor gyi bskyis bskyil/ dang bskyin pa bskyal/ /gos bskon 'das pa la'o/ /rtar bskyon bskyar nas bskrad/ / uts+tsha ṭi ta/ gcom 'jigs pas skad chung ngu'am kha rog 'dug pa/ bskyung zas bskru gzhan la thabs kyis/ bskyed bskyed pa la smra rgyan las bkyed ces sa mgo med pa bshad mod/ at+pā ta 'brad pa/ cing bskrun/ bskyed/ /bskal bskal pa dus kyi/ la za ma tog tu ka kyang mdzad pa jo nang lo tsā bas sgra sor bzhag du bshad pa ltar mdzad kyi bod skad la bas 'phul sa mgo yod pa 'di kha 'thad/ mes mtsho bskams shuṣ+ka/ chu bskyil/ / 'khyil ba'i bskyil/ pra yaṅka/ bskyal/ / gnas su/ bskal don bar chod pa'am rgyang ring ba/ bskungs shing 'jigs bskyabs trā ṇi ta/ bskyangs/ pā li ta/ /'pho bskyas rkyang bskyur bya ba bskyungs/ /mi bskyod ak+ṣo bh+ya/ bskor pra rak+ṣi ṇa/ ba rgyal sar bskos/ /ro bska ka ṣā ya/ kha bskang pūr+ṇa/ thugs dam bskangs/ /sems bskyed ut+pād/ rgya bskyed brjed bkur ba'i don/ pa'i bskyud/ mu ṣi ta sma ra/ /bas 'phul sa mgo dpag tu med pa'i brda rnying bskyad du med sogs dang bska sla'ang 'di kha/ ldan pa'i gcod pa'i bskrus pa sogs/ ka'o/ /go khrab barma/ khri pra bhe da/ phrag khrag khrig pra yu ta/ khur/ /khong khro pra ti gha/ khon 'dzin kro dha/ bo khros/ / kro pi ta/ khro dang khrol tshags khrud khus khrus/ / khang la dugs khang zer/ / snā da/ khong khrag rak+ta/ khrag 'thab krol dang 'dzing pa/ khrug khrung kruñtsa/ khrung 'dab chags/ khyu/ /tshul khrims shī la/ khrims 'jags khrims dam rgyal zer/ kyi khral/ daṇ+ḍa/

/khru gang khrun 'phang ngam srid/ ring khram kha khra/ /khrom khrod khri ā sa na/ steng khang khyim gri bha/ sdum pa zer/ khyams/ /bya khra khyis khyer khyor ba'i khre/ pra yaṅku/ /khor ra khor khor zug kyang zer/ yug khron chu brems/ /sil ladzhal+la rī/ khrol khams gsum khram pas khrel/ /dur sh+ma shā na/ khrod sna na ya ti/ khrid khrums stod pūrba bha dra pa da/ smad/ ut+ta ra bha dra pa da/ /khwa kā ka ta la sogs khyab pa'i don la chib pa dang / kha rkyang ngo / /mkhan u pā dh+ya ya/ pos sa mkhar ko ṭa/ mkhrang mkhregs mkhyen/ dzñā na/ /mkhyud man ngag phran bu sbas te 'chad pa/ spyad muṣ+ṭi/ dpe chos ston 'os pa la'ang sba ba/ zhu mkhan mkho/ /ma ma le/ mkhal mkhal ma mkhur 'dzum mkhas/ pa ṭu/ /mkhan khrod mkhos phab snga sngar bzhin/ mkho bzhin/ /mkha' mnyam am+pa ra/ mkhris nad med par mkhyen/ dzña na/ chu mkhris mkhrig ma mas 'phul kha'o/ /blo 'khums zhe 'khon 'khangs shing 'khu/ dro ha/ /'khyags shī ta/ nas mtha' khobs khyas pa lta bu'i don dang 'khos zhes ngan pa tsam la'ang zer/ 'khyar zhing 'khyams/ /rgas 'khogs 'khos chung rkang 'khums 'khyog /'khyor 'khyoms 'khar bas 'khril 'khris 'khyud/ ā liṅga / /gdugs 'khyir bro 'khrab 'khar rnga 'khrol/ /sems 'khol sems 'khrug ā yu dha/ 'khyug por 'khyus/ bros pa/ /khur 'khur bhā ri ta/ khral 'khris 'od 'khyims pa ri dhi/ 'khyil/ /'khor bar 'khrin pas 'khras shing 'khar/ /ma 'khyig ban+dha na/ ma 'khyer na ya na/ snum skog zan kyang zer/ 'khur 'khur/ /ma 'khur bred 'khrims 'khams shing 'khun/ /'khor lor 'khod kyang 'khor bcas 'khob/ /g.yog tu 'khul 'phol srad bu 'khal/ /'khrad sar ma 'khyol 'khrid na ya ti/

par 'khums/ /rus kyi 'khon sogs ngag 'khyal la'ang 'di ka sam+bhan+na/ 'khrig 'khrul bsgyur ba'i 'khyur bro khrab 'khru sbyongs 'khrungs 'khrud sogs/ 'as 'phul kha'o/ /grub mthas grub sid+dha/ thob grangs a sam̐ khya/ med grol/ / mak+ti/ ral gri khaḍ+ga/ gro gas gril zhes grag kil/ /grul bum grang shī ta/ nad grum bus grongs/ /mon gru nam gru gre gro bzhin/ /chos ko ṇa/ grwa'i gral paṅk+ti/ du rim sat+kā ra/ gro'i grabs/ /yul gru gru bzhi gru kha'i grong / /gra kiṃ shā ru/ snye ma'i gra dang shing gra ma sogs/ ma spu gra gru 'dzin ri/ /mon lug gla sgang gro'i go dhu ma/ sbang grum/ /gra phug gro+o ma mon sran gre'u/ /grod pa gron zan gron che sogs/ can grung rig pa/ zhing grim/ / rig pa/ sha skud pa sogs/ gram pa'i chu grogs gre bo'i grogs/ po la smos 'drin yang zer/ /grib ts+tshā ya/ mar gros mol ba'am gtam/ gleng re gron med/ /gla kas+d+yū ri/ rtsi gla rngan glud srog gi ltar glen/ rig pa/ /'dzam gling dwī pa/ glegs bam pusta ka gling pang+sha/ bu'i glu/ / gī ti/ /pho glang glang shu glog pa'i nad/ /glo ba'i glo gog leb mor glebs/ / mnan pa'i don/ ngag sgron du sa mtha' mi snang / glang chen hasti'aṃ ga dza'am̐ dan+thaṃ/ glos phab glod nas glal/ / baṃ dzṛm+bha/ seng ge bsgyengs mas seng ge glal zhes pa 'gyur byad/ glo bur 'di la ka dang ga dang ba las byas pa mang dag snang yang glo bur zhes ba las byas pa 'di rang dag ces smra rgyan du gsungs yod/ za ma tog gi dgongs pa ga las byas pa 'di rang yin no/ /glo bur glo a kasma/ 'bur glo rdeg glo rdeg ces pa'i glo bur rang yin par smyan las bshad do/ /glog mkha' klong rba klong yang 'di ka yin par za ma tog las so/

/urmi/ /glags 'jug pa'am 'gro mtshams/ rnyed lan 'dod pa ste lan glon dang le'u glon yang zer/ lan glan lhan pa glan/ /sgo glegs chos gos glegs bu'i grwa/ /gla gor shing gi sman/ zho sha glog 'khyug glongs/ /bya glag grog ma grib grib gnon/ /grog por gru mong chag grums grub/ /dngos grub gru char 'beb par grags/ /gro bo gwa dor ga rkyang ngo / / gzhogs kyi glo skar sogs kyang ske'i gre ba'ang / chu grog kyang 'di ka yin par smra rgyan las so/ /gri khug kyang 'di ka de la chan pa dang khye bo'ang zer/ dge bsnyen dge tshul dga' yid dga' la yid smo'ang zer/ nan+da/ dgyes nan+ti na/ dgod/ /dgung nam mkha'am gnam/ sngon dgu tshigs dge zhing dgu/ /nyin dgung mtshan gung dang nyin mo'o/ / rā tri/ dge bshes ka l+yā ṇa mi tra/ yod mang tshig dgu 'di la mkho dgu dang bzang dgu sogs kyang ngo / /dgu dgug /dge sbyong dge slong dge 'dun dgus/ na ba/ dgra bcom dgongs bsam pa'i abhi prā ya dgrol/ yi ger dgod/ n+yā sa/ bde la dgod/ /dgag ni ṣe dha/ bsgrub snod dgang dgon a ra ṇa/ par dgar/ /dgo ri dwags/ ba pha ba ser sha sgams bshul du skyes pa de yin/ dgo dgo dgas/ gas pa'i don/ /khal dgal lhan pa dgab 'gebs pa'i don/ dang dgog /skyes dgus dge legs dge sgrub dgos/ /dgongs mo zong dgram a ba kīr+ṇa/ me tog dgram/ a ba kīr+ṇa/ /dgon dzaṃ ga la/ chu med pa'am mya ngam gyi thang yang zer/ dung can du dgun ka bsdod/ /dgung lo la sogs das 'phul ga'o/ /bka' bgros bgro siṅgā ti/ ba ni/ gleng ba/ bgyi bya ba/ ka ro maṃ/ bgyid byed pa/ ka ra ṇa/ bgyis/ byas pa/ /kṛ ta/ go cha/ bgos san+na d+dha/ bgegs bigh+na/

kyis bgrod lam bgags/ /dus 'gyangs brkyangs pa zhes pa'ang 'thad par gsungs/ tshod nyams tshod dam tshod lta ba/ bgam bgo gyon rgyu'i gos/ ba bsatra/ bgos/ san+na d+dha/ /bgres bid+dha/ pos mig bgrad bsgrad ces pa'ang 'thad/ bgrang phreng bgrangs/ ga ṇi ta/ /bgrus pa'i 'bras bgos gad mo bgad/ /gom pa bgom zhing rnyog ma bgrungs/ dwangs su bcug pa'am grungs brgyab pa/ /bgo skal la sogs 'gab bam smad kyi don la bgab ces byed pa smra rgyan las bshad do/ /bas 'phul ga'o/ /mgo shi raḥ mgur kaṇ+ṭha kan+dha ra/ mgul mgrin grī ba/ mgon nā ba/ mgon po mgu/ tuṣ+ṭa/ ba la gzha' ba'ang zer/ /mgal dum mgal me gtor mgron 'di lam gyi 'gron po dang mi gcig pas 'di ka rang / mgyogs/ tūr+ṇa/ pa la dang rkyen pa'ang / /mgar a ya skā ra/ ba la sogs las 'phul ga'o/ /'gro dbyer ba'ang zer/ ka ma na/ 'greng ut+thi ta/ 'grim 'grul 'gying 'gros bskyad pa'ang zer/ sbad+dha/ 'gran/ pa'i zla la 'gran to'ang zer/ /'grangs bhā ri ta/ 'gengs 'gag 'gog ni ro dha/ 'gags ni ru d+dha/ 'gas gas rgyu'i don dang 'ga'i 'gas/ 'khrig /'gyangs ā lam+bi ta/ 'gor bi lam+bha/ bul ba dang nyul ba'ang zer/ 'gyas 'grogs dgongs 'grel dṛt+ti/ 'grol/ mdud pa 'grol ba'ang / /'gyem 'grel 'grongs ma ra ṇa/ 'gum 'ga' ka sh+tsi ta/ re 'ga' dang la 'or 'ga' zer/ 'gras dwiṣ+ṭa/ 'gyod/ kau kṛ t+ya/ 'gyed pa'ang zer/ /'gol par 'gram 'gul kam+pa na/ nor tso da/ 'gye 'gyed/ / tso ti tā/ 'grems pa/ 'gan 'khur 'gong po'i 'go le pa/ nad 'gos li pi ta/ /'phel 'grib 'gyur k+ṣa ra/ 'gyus mi mi zhum pa/ de la mi gu'ang zer/

'gong dang / /lam 'gron 'di la mas 'phul spang / 'gal bi ruta dha/ 'gugs rtsig 'gram ha nu/ 'god/ n+yā pa/ /brtson 'grus 'go pra mu kha/ ma'i chu 'grems a ba ki ra ṇa/ 'grus/ /mgo 'joms pa'i don/ 'gems rigs 'gre tshos kyi 'grig /'thab mo 'ged spong ba'i 'gyer ba/ sogs 'as 'phul ga'o/ /rgod po rgya mtshor rgal 'bogs pa'ang zer/ phyir rgyu/ rgyun lugs/ rgyu 'grul/ /gtam rgyud phreng rgyud rgyud bī ṇa/ mang rgyan/ ā laṅka ra/ bya gṛ dhaṃ/ rgod bṛd+dha/ rgan po rga shis dza ra ma ra ṇa/ rgud/ ā pa ta/ /phas rgol bā dī/ rgyang phan mgo la rgyob/ /rgod ma'i rgyab pṛṣ+ṭha/ rgyas rgyang ring ā ta ra/ rgyug dhā ba/ /rgya bo dbu rgod phyag mu tra/ rgyar gshos pa dang 'khrig pa'ang / bgrod/ ga ti/ /rgya tsha rgyam tsha rgyags phye'i rgyugs/ /rgyu mtshan lo rgyus bying rgod rgyu/ /rgyal ba'i rgyud rā ṭa/ rgyal po/ rgyu skar rgyal/ /shes rgyud rgyas btab nga rgyal rgyags/ /rgya gram rgyan la mdung dor dang skabs thob kyi cho lo'ang zer/ po rgyan ā laṅka ra/ dang rgyal/ /rgun 'brum rgya shug nya rgyar dzā la/ rgyud/ /rgyus pa snā yu/ rgyu ma an+t+ra/ lug gu rgyud/ /gru rgyong rgyang shing mig rgyu'i mig gi skyong ma'am dri ma/ rgyun/ /rgya yul rgya sa mu tra/ mtsho lto rgyab skyid/ /rgyal mtshan rgyal dza ya/ sogs rar btags ga'o/ /lus kyi lgang au da rī ya ka pa sman 'di gnyis za ma tog las snga rabs pa 'ga' zhig bzhed gsungs/ yang sman sna dang / rgyam tshwa'ang 'thad gsungs/ lga dang / /lagyam sen+dha pa/ tshwa la smra rgyan las rta sga la sa mgo dang la mgo 'dam nga can du gsungs/ la ga btags so/

/sgom bhā ba ka chen blo zab pa/ sgam smra rgyan las bas 'phul snang / sgrin pa ṭu/ por spar+dha/ sgrun/ 'gran pa/ /lcags sgrog sgor drat+ta/ mo sgrim zhing sgril/ /sgyid sā lā sa/ skyur sgyid lug sgyed tsu li/ bu sgyel/ /sgyu rtsal ka lā/ g.yo shā th+ya/ sgyu sgyu mā ya k+ṣa ra/ ma sgrung / sngon rabs/ /sgam mañdzu kha/ sgrom sgro ba sgye'u sgye/ /sgyug shwa shu rī/ mos sgo nga aṇ+ḍa/ sgog pa/ la shu ṇa/ sgog skya la ra su ni 'am/ la shu/ ri sgog la ni ki'u ni/ zos sgreg uṅgā ra na zer/ /sdig sgrib chu sgrol tā ra/ chos sgra ru ta/ sgrogs/ /bya sgro rgod sgro go bo'i sgro sogs/ bshad sgros mchu sgros sku sgros gtsang mi gtsang sogs/ sgrig 'grig par sgrig pa/ /sgal tshigs pṛṣ+ṭha baṃ sa/ sgul skyod sga sge'u kha 'dam 'ang zer/ bca' lga dang ro nus cha mthun zhig gi ar rta/ gsher/ /sgren nag+na/ gcer bu/ mo sgo sgo glegs la sgo 'phar zer ba'ang / drung sgeg lā s+yā/ mo sgug sgo srung / /sgyid par sgro gus sgrog /dbang sgyur 'khor lo sgyur sgyur byed/ /lag sgreng zas paṇ+ḍi ya/ sgong bu ram sgor/ /sgar dang rta sga sgron me dī pa/ sgrib/ ā ba ra ṇa/ /srid sgrub klu sgrub sā dha na/ sgrol ma sgrub/ tā ra/ /mna' sgog sgyug rdos sgu do gcog /da sgos sgos su rtsig pa sgron/ /sgu stegs sgang gshongs tsha ba tsha can/ sgo can/ /sgrob dang sgrom sogs sar btags ga'o/ /brgal brtag brgal lan brgyad a shī ti/ bcu brgyad/ aṣ+ṭa/ /phreng ba brgya phrag bi gu la/ brgyus gra thi ta/ pas brgyan/ brgyan pa la gzhags pa'ang zer/

a lang kri ta/ /chu brgal tīr+ṇa/ 'o brgyal dran med brgyal/ 'bog pa'ang zer/ /brgyud pa raṃ pa ra bla ma brgyud pa dang mi brgyud sogs/ pa lam brgyags bco ba'i brgyad/ 'thab pa'am smad pa'am gshe ba sogs la zer/ pa ri bhā ṣa/ /le brgan gad brgyangs smra ba'i mkhas brgya bar zad ces bka' yang dag pa'i tshad ma las bshad/ ā la pa/ brgyad/ /brgyugs dhā pa ti/ shing brgyung pa brgyud mar brgyas/ /dbyug pa brgyab sogs bas 'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i/ ga'o/ /bu ram bsgar zhing bsgrangs nas bsgongs/ /chos bsgyur brti ta/ mdog bsgyur bka' bsgo bsgos/ /chu bsgral chos bsgrags kīrti ra/ ting 'dzin bsgom/ /mgo pe ya la/ bsgres rigs bsgres mgo bsgres pa la sgres rkyang yang 'thad par gsungs/ rgyal mtshan bsgrengs/ sgreng zhes pa'ang 'thad gsungs/ uts+tsh+ra ya/ /mna' bsgags lam bsgugs seng ge bsgyings/ bidz+ri m+bha/ 'gyur kha cig tu glal zhes pa dang don gcig /bag chags bsgo bsgos phyogs gcig bsgrigs/ ga thi ta/ /'od bsgribs sgrib pas bsgribs sogs/ blo bsgrims 'das pa/ srad bu bsgril/ /bsgrub bya ba/ pa bsgrub swadh+ya/ bya bsgrun mi nus/ /bsgrin mi mi mchog pa'i don/ phod dang bya ba'i bsgang / gang dang gang gi dngos gzhi de'o/ /bsgyel sgyed bu lta bu bsgyel tshar ba'i don/ zhing sgra bsgrags rtsis kyis bsgyur/ /gzhan gyis mi bsgul a k+ṣo bh+ya/ nor gyis bsgangs/ smra rgyan las gang ba'i don gsungs/ /gan skyal bsgyel 'das pa la'o/ /sogs bas 'phul sga'o/ /snyan kā bya/ dang ngag ces kyang 'thad par bzang / zil dngar bdud rtsi/ tshar du gral lam 'phreng ba lta bur bsgrigs pa/ dngar/ /gser dngul ru pyai/ dngom che dngos bha ba/

dngos a bhā ba/ med/ /dngos grub sid+dha/ dngos gzhi mū la/ dngos bshams dngos/ dhā ba/ /dngangs snga sa zhes kyang 'thad par gsungs pa/ smra rgyan las 'das ma 'das kyi khyad yin par gsungs/ skrag san+tā sa ni/ dngan gzhan gyi nor khyer ba phyir mi gtod pa/ 'then 'bab chu'i dngo'/ chu ngogs/ /gri yi dngo ngos sam so 'am zheng la'ang / sogs ro dngar/ de la mngar zhes kyang 'thad par gsungs/ das 'phul nga'o/ /mnga' ris mnga' zhabs mnga' thang mnga'/ /mnga' mdzad mnga' bi bhu/ bdag mngag kiṅka ra/ bran dang ci bgyis dang / /gzhug g.yog sogs/ gzhan yang rtse rgod dang / lha 'bangs/ nang byan sogs kyang ngo / /mngags/ /mngon pra t+yak+ṣa/ sum mngon gyur mngon mtshan mngal/ gar+bha/ /mngon spyod mnga' brnyes mngan mi bgrang / /chos mngon a bhi/ mngon a bhi dzña/ shes das 'phul can gyi dngar dang 'dam kha yin kyang smra rgyan las 'di kha kho nar bzhed do/ /mngar ba'i ro/ /thugs la dhṛka mnga' sogs mas 'phul nga'o/ /rngon sha ba ra/ ri dwags gsod byed/ pa'i rnga yab rnga brdung ba'i/ dun+du bhi/ rnge'u dud 'gro rnga mo'i uṣ+ṭa phrug gu la rnge'u zer ba'o/ /chung dang / /rngams pa'i bkres rngab smra rgyan las bkres sngam zhes bshad/ rnga mo rnge'u/ /rngom brjid rngam brjid rngom bag can/ /dbugs prā shwā sa/ rngub smra rgyan du bas 'phul bshad do/ /zug sha l+ya/ rngus rngod mkhan rngul/ swe da/ rngul gzan kyang ngo / /saṃ kak+ṣi/ /rngos khyer dre'u rngog gla rngan pa ste gsug pa'ang zer/ rngan dang / /rnga tsā ma ra/ rngog ma zhes pa ze ba/ thugs rngams rngo mi thog /rngan chan rtsa rnga rngu ma dang / /rus kyi rngog dang rnga yab gling / /ra la btags pa'i grangs kyi lnga la la la nga btags kho na/

nga yig go /zhal pā da/ snga spyan a gra ta/ snga snga pūr+wa/ so sngon/ nangs kyi ni sngon gyi zer/ /gsang sngags man+t+ra/ sngags man+t+ri/ pa mdog sngon sngo/ nī la/ snga pūrbā h+ṇa/ /dro sngas la sngur pa che/ /snga pūr+wa/ dus skyo sngogs mon sran snge'u/ /snga phyi pūrā/ sngun du sngo bar pa ri ṇā ma na/ byed/ /mtshang nas sngog sogs sar btags nga'o/ /brngan mchod pa/ yang brngams nas rtsas ma brngas/ lu p+ta/ /bud re ma zer/ med brngod dang brngon pas brngon/ /chang brngubs bas 'phul rar btags nga'o/ /sdug duḥkha/ bsngal bstod saṃ bar+ṇa/ bsngags bsngo ba pa ri ṇā ma/ bsngos/ 'di rigs la smra rgyan las rang gzhan dang bya byed rtsi dgos par gsungs/ /rnam par bsngos nī li ta/ pa'i 'du shes ni kha dog bsngos pa lta bu/ dang bsngogs pa sogs/ /ba yis 'phul ba'i sar btags nga'o/ /ci slad ci ka tha/ phyir ldan pa'i can/ mig can dang / ldan can sogs/ /bdag cag spyi cer khal+li ṭa/ sum dring+sha ta/ cu dang / /drug cu ṣaṣ+ṭhi/ bdun sap+ta ti/ cu brgyad a shī ti/ cu rnams/ /lhan cig chabs cig kyang zer/ thabs cig skad k+ṣa ṇa/ cig tsam/ /khyed cag sems can sa twa/ yod do cog mtha' dag gi don/ /can can ni grong tshig yin gsungs pa smra rgyan las so/ /cer cob cob chang co re/ /ha a tam̐/ cang cas cus bab bab baba'ang zer/ col tsam/ / don ma brtags par 'phral du smras pa/ ci ste cung kiñtsi ta/ zad phyin ci log /cang shes dza ni ya/ cig shos i ta ra/ ci nas kyang / /co to'i thor cog thor mu gu ṭa/ pan dang / /rgya aṣ+ṭaṃ tsakaṃ cang ska rags kyi bye brag dang yod pa dang legs so gya nom snang ba la sogs/ be ga dā/

con lta ci smos/ /ca to'i col col mu kha zer ba dang / cor kha drag pa/ dang / /co g.yen spyo 'ang zer don la sdang bar byed pa dang / 'tho 'tshams pa'o/ /'dri cig yu ga pa ta/ car tsam gyis 'jog /cog bur ca re mig ce re/ /lan cig 'di grangs kyi bu gcig yin kyang gsung rab kun nas 'di ka 'byung zhes smra rgyan las gsungs/ cis kyang cir mi rtog /kha cig cang mi shes kyang cong / rol mo/ /cang smra rgyan las gshang zhes pa sgra tshig yin par gsungs nas bon gyi gshang la cang zer gsungs/ dang cang te'u ḍā ma ru/ ci yang rung / /cu gang cung zhi cur sman dpyad las phya ma'i ming du bshad snang ba de yin no/ /nis za/ /ce lce spyang dang lcags spyang sogs ma dag pa kho na yin no/ /spyang co ga brag cas ci/ / ka thaṃ/ cog cer tho cos cung sed za/ /ci ga la sogs ci rkyang ngo / /gros gcom gcong nad gcad bya gcod/ ts+tshe da na/ /khon mi mdza' ba/ gcugs yid gcugs āp+ta/ mdza' ba/ gcen a gra dza/ sngon skyes/ dang gcung / rjes skyes so/ /a nu dza/ /gcud bor lag gcud gcur zhing gcun/ /rnam gcod yongs gcod zhal lce gcod/ /gcong rong gcong skad gcin mū tra/ 'di gnyis dri chu'i ming / gci ba/ /gcod yul/ bzhin gces 'dzin/ med gcig gis gcig la gshe ba lta bu/ /gcam gcos ma/ bu kha gcang gcugs med gces/ spras/ /tshar gcod gcu gal yid la gcags/ kai kṛ taṃ/ /sgra rā hu/ gcan gcan shwa pa da/ gzan la gcan la'i tshugs len pa po/ pa/ /gcig tu gnyig tu'ang zer/ gcal bkram grangs kyi thos pa'i dus gcig sogs kyang grangs kyi gcig 'di ka dgos par smra rgyan las gsungs/ e ka gcig /ro gcig du ma min pa'i don/ rdzas gcig gcer bur rgyu gu can yang zer/

gcog dam bur/ /gce'u'i mas gsus lta bu bshang lam sogs nas gtong ba'i sman sbyor zhig gi ming yin ces smra brgyan las bshad/ sman sogs gas 'phul gca'o/ nor 'jal ba'i gcal kyang ngo / /bcom ldan bha ga ban/ dgra ar+ha te/ bcom bcas dam dem/ pas bcags/ /dam bca' khrims bca' bcing bas ban+dha/ bcings/ /shing bcad tshin+da/ rlan bcir bca' yos bcom/ /tshigs bcad bca' gzhi bstan bcos shāsatra/ bcangs/ /logs bcar bca' sga bza' bca'i bcud/ /mig bcar phyir bcil chu bcur bcug pra k+ṣi bha/ /nor bcal lag bcangs nor bcangs pa sogs/ chags bcag bcol/ /bcags chags pa/ pas rtar bcibs zhon pa/ zhal lce bcad/ /tshar bcad blos bcal bcas rang bcabs/ sbas pa/ /rdo bcag shing bcer gros bcams bcum/ /bcu da sha dang bzhi bcu tsa twī raṃ shrata/ lnga pañtsa sha ta/ bcu dang / /dgu bcu na ba ti/ bco pañtsa da sha aṣ+ṭa da sha 'di gnyis la sgra rgyan las na ro'i/ lnga bco brgyad bcos/ /bcos bu'i ras sogs bas 'phul ca'o/ /gnyen lcug lcug phran lcang ni tsu la/ ma'i lcag /mgo lcogs me tog dang sbrul mgo sogs mgo rgyan la/ ches lci blo yis lcogs/ /gnam lcags as+ya/ lce a sha ni/ 'bab me lcer artse/ lceb/ /lcang lo a ṭa ta/ can gyi lcags ri'i lcog shing thag kyang zer/ /nya lcib sbal lcong lcung za ma tog las skyung ka bshad/ ga'i lce/ /re'u lcag lca ba lcam pa lcum/ /lag lcibs tsha lcibs sgo lcibs dang / /spyan lcibs lcam dral skra'i lcang lo/ /lci ba lcags ska rags kyi bye brag pod srus cag lcig /tshig snyad 'dogs pa la lce ston zer ba'o/ /gcig pa la sogs lar btags ca'o/ /chem chem chal chal chos chu'i na dī/ char/ /chags bral chog shes cho ga'i ched/ /go ka ba tsa/

ya lad zer/ cha mtshon cha'i cha lugs chos/ dharma/ /byang chub bar chad cham la phob/ /rin rat+na/ chen chun dā ma/ po chabs gcig chur/ /chu ā ro ta/ zheng pa rī ṇa ha/ cha mnyam chams me ba/ /chibs pa yu ga cha de chibs las chogs/ /srog chags chag chag chal mar gdab/ /cho los sho'am rgyan po 'gyed pa/ che ge'i 'di zhes bya'i/ cha rkyen chad/ /chad pa daṇ+ḍa/ chod la chung ma chol/ /chang ma t+yi/ chems che chung thugs su chud/ khong du chud pa la mong du chung pa zer ba sogs/ /mthar chags chags chogs chir gyi chir/ /chab 'og chom rkun ches cher chun/ /choms shig chings shig chab sgo chog /tshar chod thag chod chab chab ces pa yod pa rnams zhe sa'i tshig go /'og chug cha cho ma chod cha rgyus med/ med chas/ /zan changs 'bras chan chab nas chus/ /cha lang mal cha che a che'am sring mo la'ang / zhe'i smra rgyan du 'di bza' zla la ngos bzung 'dug go /chas/ /cho rigs chud zos cham pa'i nad/ /chab shog kha 'phrin/ chems chig rkyang chongs/ /bag chags cho 'phrul cho nge 'don/ /kha che chan pa cha ga srog chags/ pa/ /chol chu'i snod/ zangs chu gang snying stobs/ gor ma the tshom med pa/ de la gor ma bkum yang de nyid do/ /chag /cha shas la sogs cha rkyang ngo / /mchog tu skyabs mchi gats+tshā mi/ dkon mchog rat+na/ mchod/ pū dza na/ /mchil mas mchil lham mchig mas gtun/ mchig mas gtun/ gu/ /sku mched mchan gyi mchi chung ma/ 'brang rgyan gyis/ mchor/ /mchi ma mchil ma mcher pa mchin/ p+lī ha pa/ /zhal mchu taṇ+ḍa/ kha mchu'i bka' mchid māṃ ka te/ yang dag pa'i gtam/ mchis/ asti/ nasti/ /skye a ya ta na/ mched mching bu ka tsa/ rgya mtsho'i mching / dkyil gyi don/ /rtswa mchog me mched mchil pa'i mchongs/ pū ta/

/gzhu mchog sgyu ma'i mchan bu yi ge'i/ mchan/ /mchil lcags kyu/ pa mchims rus kyi ming / sogs mas 'phul cha'o/ /chos 'chad bhā ṣa ṇa/ khrims 'cha' 'chag tsang kra ma/ par 'chag /tshul 'chos gar 'cham nṛ t+ya/ srog 'chad ts+tsha da ni/ 'chi/ ma ra ṇa/ /'chums 'dod chags la/ pas gnas 'cha' 'chel 'chang ba zer/ sar zhen par/ 'chur/ /'chal pra la bha/ pa'i 'char sgo mi 'chags 'chab/ gsang ba'am sbed pa/ /nyi 'char u ta ya/ chu 'chor las 'chol 'chun/ /gros 'choms khas khas len pa/ 'che 'ching ban+bha na/ zhags 'chang dha ra/ /'chol go rim du mi gnas pa/ dang 'chus yo ba/ sogs 'as chud mi za ba la 'chab mi 'tshal zer ba'ang ngo / /'phul cha'o/ /ji ya thā/ lta ji snyed yā pa ta/ ji bzhin gzigs/ /ji ltar ya thā/ ji yā ba ta/ srid ji skad smra/ yā thogha/ /jo jo'i jo mo jo ar+ya/ bo'i ja/ /ji gor zhig zhig jag tsau ra/ pas ju rdo ba'o/ /po 'phangs/ /ja dmar ser/ hong ja thod pa/ hril je mthor song / /je dang dang po/ jeng sogs ja rkyang ngo / /mjal sa mā ga 'phrad mjing pa mjug ma mje/ liṅga 'am/ she pha/ /go ba'i mjal dang mi ma ha/ mjed nyon mongs la bzod pa'i ming yin/ sogs/ /ma yis 'phul ba'i ja yig go /'jag par bī ra ṇa/ 'ji ba 'jim pa 'jags/ /'jig rten lo ka 'jig pa'i lu ka 'chog pa'ang zer/ 'jigs pa bhī ta/ 'joms/ pra mardi na/ /'jus nas sha 'jog gzhog pa/ 'jar nas 'jabs/ /'ja' zhing 'jungs kri pa ṇa/ ser sna'am zhen chags che/ pa'i skyon 'jil nā shi ta/ 'jem/ /'ju ba khrag 'jib zas 'ju 'jang / /'jud smad 'tshong ma/ ga ṇi kā/ 'dod 'gro 'ang zer/ mthun 'jol 'jol 'jo sgeg 'jog

/'jur srad bu'i/ smra rgyan du mas 'phul bshad do/ /dang dbyibs 'jong 'jur zhing 'jun/ /'jog po lus 'jam mṛ du/ rgya/ mtsho 'jings 'jug /'jam dbyangs snyan 'jebs 'grogs pa'am legs pa snyan pa yid du 'ong ba sogs kyi don/ mnyam par 'jog /blos 'ja' tshad 'jal 'dod pa 'jo/ /khrigs 'jags 'ja' sa 'ja' sa rim/ mo 'jor/ /'cha' rdeg 'ja' tshon 'chor bu dang / /srod 'jing sha 'jums rtsa 'jig mnyen/ /thob kyis thabs kyis gzhan nor 'gugs pa/ 'jal sogs 'as 'phul ja'o/ /rje btsun bhaṭ+ṭā ri ka rjes a su brta/ 'jug rdo rje'i badz+ra/ rjes/ /rje dpon ar+ya/ lha bid+ya/ rje rjed bkur ba'i don rim gros sogs/ pa'i 'os/ / artsa na/ sa rjen sha kra bya/ rjen rje ngar rjud/ ā pa ta/ /rjod byed snying rje'i lag rjes dang / /thugs rjes rjes bskyangs rje'u'i rigs/ /til gyi ljang sogs rar btags ja'o/ /brjed dran pa mi gsal ba/ ngas mu ṣi ta smṛ ti/ brjed byed a bhasmā ra/ gzi te dza/ brjid dpal brjid sogs/ brjid/ /brje dngos po sogs tshong don/ brjes ma brjed brjod bā ts+ya/ bya brjod/ /ba 'phul ra mgo ldan pa'i ja'o/ /yul ljongs ljang stamā/ bu'i ljan mi gtsang ba'i/ ljin khrod/ /ljon tru ma/ shing ljid lci sman dza na pa ta/ ljong ljang / ha ri ta/ /ro 'dzin ljags dzi hwā/ sogs lar btags ja'o/ /nyams rtogs pa ga ti/ nying khu nyab cig nyab/ /nya ma nyag mo nyis 'gyur nyung / /spu nyag nya nyil nya lto pa/ /nyam nyes nyon kle sha mongs nyam ngar nye/ /nying rang sha'o/ /sha'i nyod zas/ pa nyes 'byung nyen/ /nyam chung nyam thag nyin mtshan nyal/ /nying dgos spos nyug nyan thos nyams/ /nya sha mat+sa/ nyag ga nyi shu nyos/ krī ta/

/nying dor chu nyog nye khrus/ reg nyangs/ /nyer gnas nyug rlig phyung ba/ rum nyan rna nyid/ /nyag phran mda'/ nya rgyas nye zho legs pa skyon med pa bkra shis pa sogs la 'jug med/ /ro nye zha nye nag po/ la sogs nya rkyang ngo / /dpung pa rā ya na/ gnyen bshes mi tra/ gnyen gnyis dwi/ kyi gnyen/ bun+dhu/ /gnya' shing yu ga na/ gnyer baṇ+ḍar pa khro bhṛ ku ṭi/ gnyer dang / /bka' btsan pa'i/ gnyan gnyan sa bdag nad dud 'gro gnyan/ /gnya' dpang po/ bo don gnyer gnyan lo/ gnyags rgyus/ gnyos/ lo/ /gnyid ni dra/ kyi gnyen pra ti bhak+ṣa/ por gnya' ltag gnyul/ /gnyi zer gnyig gcig tu/ tu lung gnyong chung / /gnya' reng gnye an+d+ra gu ṇa/ nang khrol/ ma nyag por gnyag /gnyug ni dza/ gnyis sam gnas lugs/ ma gnyod ka 'khos ka gas 'phul nya'o/ /mnyan pa thugs mnyes tuṣ+ṭa/ rna bas mnyan/ shra pa ṇa/ /mnyed marda na/ mnyes ko pags lta bu/ mardi ta/ shing mnyes/ mṛ du/ mnyan shrā+e bsti/ yod gnas/ /mnyam sa mā ti/ bzhag mnyel med mtshungs pa'i mnyam/ sa ma/ /ra mnye sman/ mnyes rde'u/ bshin mas 'phul nya'o/ /'dam rnyog kalka/ rnyed bkur gsar rnying rnying pa la snyis pa'ang zer/ pu ra ṇa/ rnyed/ lab+dha/ /so rnyil rnil yang zer/ dan+ta māngs/ rnyang ma mi gtsang ba/ rnyong ri dwags kyi rgya lta bu/ dang rnyi/ /lcang rnyid ma rnyol an+da rnyil/ /rkang rnyong rkang pa skyong ba/ rnyan gnyan zhes pa'ang snang / rwa rar btags nya'o/ /go a dza dzī/ snyod snying sā ra/ po rnyi mo'i snying / puk+ka/ /spu snyol khro ba skyung ba'i don/ chang snyol snye phung snyil/ /tha snyad byā bā hā ra/ ji snyed de snyed snyam/ /snyems dang garba/

snyun nad ro ga med snyan kar+ṇa/ shal snyi/ mi sra ba'i/ mṛ du/ /snyoms 'jug btang snyoms a pek+ṣa/ snyoms tan+d+ri/ las ngang / /bsod beṇ+ṭa/ snyoms snyugs ring snye sor snyogs/ /snying rjes snyim pa snyom la snye/ /snyon mongs nyon mongs/ snyad 'dogs rgyal mtshan snyol/ /gtam ma dhu ra/ snyan snyigs dus kalga/ skud pa snyod/ /snyang le lo lta bu/ snyong sems sa ya/ snyoms sar nas kyi snye mang la'o/ /btags nya'o/ /dge bsnyen u pā sa ka bsnyen gnas u pa bā sa/ bsnyen u pa sam+pan+na/ rdzogs bsnyen/ /bsnyon can bsnyon dor bsnyon rol dang / /gtam bsnyad bsnyams nas lag pa bsnyal/ lag pa bkrus pa/ /phyir bsnyil phyir bskrad pa/ pa ta tu/ mal bsnyan lhung bzed bsnyigs/ /lag bsnyabs snyun gyis bsnyun snyun zhes pa nad kyi ming yin la 'di ni tsha bas bsnyun zhes pa lta bu brten pa'i ming ngo / /pas bsnyings/ /bsnyel med nas bskor yo byad bsnyungs/ /bsnyen nye ring / bsrings zas bsnyod skyu gang bsnyugs/ /bsnyems nga rgyal/ pas rjes bsnyegs khro gnyer bsnyer/ /bsnyen bsgrub bsnyen par+yu pā sa/ bkur phye mar bsnyil/ /bas 'phul 'jigs pa'i bsnyengs sogs/ sa bha ya/ 'jigs pa'i bsnyengs sogs/ mgo ldan pa'i nya'o/ /gzugs pra ti bi mya/ brnyan pra ti shrut+ka/ sgra brnyan skra 'tshab skra brnyan sogs/ gzhan la brnyas/ g.yas pa/ /mnga' brnyes prāp+ta/ phyag brnyan 'khor g.yog brnyan po'i brnyas/ chas chod pa/ /gos brnyings kha brnyogs snang brnyan brnyang / /bas 'phul ra mgo ldan nya'o/ /te por legs par/ te ser tal mar song / /tug tug tong tong mgrin pa'i/ tog tog sgra/ /tal pa tog rtse dbyug to dang / /gtsug uṣ+ṇī ṣa/ tor tho rtor byi rtor tog ke tu/

/mu muk+ti/ tig me puṣ+pa'am phul+la/ tog tam+bu la/ /lo tog sa s+ya/ rtsi tog shing tog kyang ngo / /de la long bu'ang zer/ za ma tog /ting sa mā dhi/ 'dzin dkon ye shes ta la la zhes pa'ang yod de/ rarnol ka'i sgra dkon mchog sgron me dang / dzña nolka'i sgra ye shes sgron me zhes pa'ang 'jug mchog ta la la/ /ting lo tal tsam tig tig med/ /yon tan gu ṇa/ zhabs tog nan tan a nuṣ+ṭhā na/ dang / /nan tur chad las/ daṇ+ḍa/ gal ya di'am tsi ta/ te go ta ma/ /kha ton zhal ta nan tar bzang / /ta yul/ zig ta ta zhes pa rgya nag gi skad du chen po/ ming ta'i se tu/ /ti shi ta dben ta hung dang / /twa ra ṇa dang ti'u shang khri/ /tam bu ra dang ting ting shags/ /nyo ti ta la tre zhang zhung gi skad yin cing sman dpyad las phye ma'i don/ sle tres kyang zhang zhung gi skad yin/ bod skad ta la/ sam dang / / ra btags mi dgos zhes smra rgyan las gsungs so/ /shang shang te'u te te brdungs/ /'on tang 'on kyang / ling tog ta rkyang ngo / /gtan gyi bsam gtan dh+yā na/ gtan tshig he tu/ gtam/ ka thā/ /gtun 'di la yig rnying dag pa 'ga' na ra mgo byas pa'ang yod snang / bu lag gtad ar+pi tā/ gtun shing gtubs/ /brdung gtag gtong dang gtang d+yā ga rag gtong / /gter ni dhi/ mdzod yongs gtams tha ram zer khengs pa dang bcol ba'o/ /gtor ba li/ zan gtor/ a bi gṛ ṇa/ /nor gyi gta' ma gteng pa gta'/ 'di gsum don gcig ste 'dul ba las gta' ris rir blang bar bya'o zhes pa lta bu'o/ /gtan pa med pa'i sbyin gtong btang / /gtum tsaṇ+ḍa/ po'i rung khus za ba'ang zer/ zhabs gtugs pṛṣ+ṭa/ zad pa'i gtugs/ /lha chen gtogs 'dod gzhan la gtod/ /'ben la gtod dang dmigs pa gtod/ /gti mug gtol med thabs med pa'am rgyus med pa/

'tshang nas gtol/ /khrag gtar chu gtigs dang gtig se gol gtog dang gtogs kyang / /bcol ba'i gtams dang grangs kyi gtams/ /sgo sgo glegs/ gtan gting zabs mun pa gtibs/ /gtor bla gos kyi shubs/ bu spos gtul ri bo'i gtos/ gtos me chung zhes pa lta bu/ /mgo gtums mtha' gtugs khongs su gtogs/ /gtan la'ang 'bebs sogs gas tsaṇ+ḍā li'i/ gtum mo sogs dang / smra rgyan las ma yengs par sems gtod pa'ang gsungs/ 'phul ta'o/ /sgra btags ming btags kha btags btags/ thags ran/ /spyir ustarka/ btang blos btang t+yak+ta/ sngags btu btus/ sa muts+tsha ya/ /srol btod gdan btings a bsta ra/ sa bon btab/ up+ta/ /btang mu tsi lin+da/ bzung ri bo/ klus klu btang zung yang ngo / /bteg gsol btab btud/ zhabs la btud pa'ang / /btag tha ga pa'i/ po rgyas btab bza' btung rtsang nan yang zer/ btub/ rung ba/ /spu btogs rtsa bton btags phye mar/ shing btul/ /mgrin pa bteg gdang la btags pa'ang / sogs bas 'phul ta'o/ /mi rtag rtab mi rings pa'i ma rtabs pa'ang / rtob dbang brtul mṛ tu/ btags/ /mi rtog yid a nu sa ra/ rton rtogs a ba ro dha/ ldan rtogs/ ga ti blo gros/ /rtag tu rta la rti'u rting par+ṣ+ṇi/ skyes/ /rtol gog rting pa rtod pas bcings/ /ru rtas nyams rtas rgyas pa/ gnas su rtol/ slebs pa/ /mong rtul rtul pa rā kra sa/ snying stobs che ba/ phod rten rten 'brel/ /mchod rten rta babs bya ma nyan mna'am bang chen/ rta/ /rta thul rta dbyangs rtog ge pa/ /mi gtsang bi ṭa/ rtug sogs rnam rtog lha rten 'jig rten/ bi kalpa/ ra btags ta'o/ /lto sa 'gro'i ltag kṛ kā ṭi ka pa de ta thā/ lta bu/ /lto 'phye'i u ra ga

lte bar na bhi/ ltad mo ko tu ha la/ lta/ dṛṣ+ṭa/ /lto kuk+ṣi/ ba lto yis lter gyis bkang / /bu ltar 'grangs ltogs da lta ltos/ /ltar snang ltag chod lta driṣ+ṭa/ log gi /ltung ba ā bar+ṇi/ ltas sha ku ni/ ngan rme ngan yang zer/ lta ci smos/ /lteng rgyas lteng ka u nu bi lo/ ltem gyis u ra ga bkang / /re ltos lta zhog mda' yi ltong / /ltar pe si/ mngal du/ ltar ltem kyang lar legs pa'i don la ltos sogs/ btags lta'o/ /ston pa'i bzhugs stangs bkur sti saṅkā ra/ stob/ 'brim pa'i ster pa/ /stes dbang stabs shugs/ mu mur 'dug kyang zer/ stems byad stems kyis/ /mi sto lta driṣ+ṭi/ stangs me stag stegs/ /sta gon stong grogs sha stag byed/ /gzhogs zur mig lta bu'i sgeg chos/ stags stang stabs sta kuk+ṣi dpyi mgo zur ston/ /stod lus sogs kyis/ la stan ni ṣa da na gdan/ dang mngal ma sten/ se ba/ /ston dpyid gang stong ya stags mdos sogs la/ stong / sa ha sra/ grangs/ /stim byed so stor stor mi gtsang 'bab pa'i/ khung dang / /stang dngul rdo/ zil stabs thabs gcig pa/ gcig star rgyus steng / u pa ri/ /shing ltag stug mthug pa'i don gha na/ khrod stobs can rtsal gyi/ stag byā gra/ /dgra par+shu/ sta sta re ste'u stor/ bor ba/ /star zhun star kha'i ston mo ster/ da dā ti/ /stong shū n+ya tā/ pa stong nyid sar byin len stobs dang / star bu dang / bsti stangs sogs gsum po'ang / btags ta'o/ /brtag kalpa/ dpyad gnas s+d+ya bi ra/ brtan kun brtags pha lpi ta/ brtags/ su pa rīk+ṣa/ brtags pa gus pa'am sgrims pa/ /yid brtan brtad glo bur du/

pa ar+pi ka brtul pra ta/ dper na sha za ba'i spyod pa brtul nas mi mi za ba'i spyod pa la zhugs pa lta bu la'o/ /zhugs cha byad 'chang ba'i/ brtan/ s+d+yi ra/ /sbubs brtol ba 'phul med pa'o/ /brtun pa brtson pa'o/ /spyi brtol dpral kom thug pa'am ngo tsha chung ba/ brtabs/ /yongs 'du sa brtol brtag pa brtul/ bsdus pa'am 'jam pa/ /brten pa la brten phur bur brtod/ /bas 'phul ra mgo blun pa'i rmongs brtul dang / smra rgyan las/ brtul phod/ blog sna brtungs pa sogs la'ang bshad/ ldan ta'o/ /bltos pa bltos ches ltar rung bltas/ /blta bya sku bltams dzā ta/ skyes pa'i 'khrungs pa/ gos bltab sogs/ /bas 'phul la gang ba'i don bltams pa sogs/ mgo ldan ta'o/ /bsti stangs bstud bskyar ba/ mas bstim gnas ngal bso ba'i/ bstar/ gzabs pa'i byi dor legs par byas pa dang / spros pa sems bsgom pa dang / yod pa sogs la'ang 'jug par gsungs/ /thub bstan dang bstun bstod satro tra/ pa 'os bsten/ se ba/ /bstang bas mgon dang grogs kyis ma bzung ba/ ma bzung bstan shasatra/ chos bstan/ de sha na/ /thag bstungs thung du/ sna bstad blun po'i brda rnying / 'gro chas bstad/ /bsting sun 'byin pa'i tshig ste/ mi ngan pa la mi ya mtshan zhes brjod pa lta bu'o/ /tshig bstims thim par/ pas mi smra brgyan las byed pa'i bstongs pa la bas 'phul dgos par gsungs/ stongs kyang / /bstir med mnar med dam ngal bso med pa/ mngon bstod gsung pa la mngon par/ byin len bstabs/ brims pa'am byin pa/ /bas 'phul sa mgo ldan ta 'o/ /thun mong thu bo tha gru che/ / rgya khyon yin la/ de ma thag gru'ang zer/ /thu mi thor do ker can la yang zer/ cog thur tshugs dang /

/tha ma tha na thrig 'dul ba lung las lham gyi sgra skad/ thrig sgra/ /thur dang tha mal tha rkyang ngo / /mtho ris go mtha' dag sa ka la/ mtha' klas mthong / dṛṣ+ṭa/ /mthar mur thug kyang zer/ thug nus mthu a nu bha ba/ mthun a nu ku la/ mi pra ti bū la/ mthun/ /lag 'drag mthil kyang zer/ mthil ta la/ mthe a guṣ+ṭa/ bong mthe'u ka niṣ+ṭha/ chung / /mthon dang mthon in+d+ra nī la/ mthing mthang an+tarba sa/ gos mthar/ /mthar gyis rim gyis/ rta mthur mtho hasta/ gang mtho/ dpangs kyi/ /mtho mtshams mthol smra ba'am mi sbed pa/ bshags mtho yor mthong / un+na/ /mthon po'i rgya mthongs mtha' 'khob mtha'/ an+tā /mthing ril mthing nī la/ kha mas 'phul tha'o/ /'thab ka la ha/ mor 'thon yang grogs su 'thams/ byams pa/ /sprin 'thibs ga hi ta/ chu 'thor 'thor 'thung dang / /blo 'thums mgo 'thums du ba 'thul/ dhū ma ya ti/ /sra 'thas 'them 'thems nan tan 'than/ mi 'than po lta bu/ /chu 'thungs pa pau/ sha nas 'then zhing 'thogs/ /smod tshig 'thing slad 'then thag pa 'then pa'o/ /pa 'thad/ u pa pa ti/ /zas la 'thud 'thus phye mar 'thag /zhwa 'theng khañdza/ mal gos 'theb kyis 'thu/ / me tog 'thu ba sogs kyang ngo / /dum bu 'thud sogs nan chags 'thebs pa dang / bshags pa'i 'thol ba la'ang rung ba/ 'as 'phul tha'o/ /gzhan dring no ya/ mi 'jog bka' pra ma da/ drin dran/ sma ra/ /dri gan+dha/ mchog dril bu ghaṇ+ṭā/ bu dra dra h+la ra/ phyed/ ad+dha hā ra/ /snga pūrbā h+ṇa/ dro phyi a pa rā h+ṇa/ dro dri pra sh+na/ dri pra sh+not+ta ra/ lan/ /drang don g.yu shā shwa ta/ drung drang song ṛ ṣi/ drug ṣa ṭa/ /khrims dral bcom pa'am zhig pa/

lcam dral zas drangs drongs/ /drang gnam po zer/ po'i shing mū pa/ drung dre'u stan khra bo'i ming te la lar par btang zer la/ de sang brum rtse zhes rgya nag skad du grags so/ /rngog /mon dre smin drug ma a na pa tap+ta/ dros mtsho/ /dreg nad dreg pa dri m+la/ ma dang / /kha drag drag u gra/ phrul sa la drud/ /drod uṣ+ṇa/ dang dro ba zan dron dril/ /dred ta rak+ṣa/ lpags dras drub pa ni tshems pa/ drubs pa ni btsems pa'o/ /drubs dred mas drags/ /dred po dru pho long zer/ bu'i gru gu grong tshig dra bar drangs/ spyan drangs sogs/ /dril bsgrags lits+tsha bī/ dra ya ram+sa dra ba/ ma'i gnas su drongs/ mtho ris su drongs sogs/ /dregs nga rgyal la sogs kyi/ dar+pa/ pa drung phyung kha yi drog /nad drag drwa phug drwa ma'i 'bru/ /thal ba'i drags sogs da rkyang ngo / /gdugs ts+tsha tra/ med gdong mu kha/ pa gdugs nyi ma/ di na/ kyis gdungs/ pa ti ta/ /gdon ltar gra ha/ gdug duṣ+ṭa/ pa'i gdol tsaṣ+ḍā la mu to ba'am rigs ngan/ pa 'dul/ gdul zer/ /gdams a ba dā na/ ngag gsal gdab gding ni ṣa da na/ ba gdan/ ā sa na/ /gdang dang gdung mar gdu lag gdub/ ru tsa ka rkang gdub/ nū pu ra/ sor gdub/ pa ri ka ṭaṅka / bu gdags/ /gdung rus skad gdangs skas kyi gdang / /gdung brgyud gdung 'dzin gsol gdab gdon/ 'don pa/ /gnyer gdams bcol gdams rnyed la gdu/ thug pa gdu ba'ang / /ming gdags bsnyung gdangs sa bon gdab/ ba pa na/ /kha gdegs mtshon gdengs gdon mi za/ /da gdod sol gdal gdeng thog gda'/ /gdos pa kha cig rlung g.yor thogs pa zhes par bsgyur mo za ma tog bkod pa na gdos pa 'dzin par bsgyur 'dug don la gru'i dar po che 'dzin pa'i ming ngo /

/kar+ṇa dha ra/ 'di thad kar bsgyur na rna ba 'dzin pa zhes par 'gyur ba zha lu lo chen gsungs/ thud gdar srang la gdegs/ /gdags pa'i bstan bcos gdam deng sang 'dam ka zer ba grong tshig nga byed/ /gdengs can gdul bya dam la gdags/ /khyab gdal gdod ā di/ nas gdags gzhi bral/ /gdangs can kun ra gas 'phul da'o/ /bdag āt+ma/ bden bdud mā ra/ bdun sat+pa/ mdun du mdun nas bstod pa'am mdun pa bgyis pa/ bdar/ pu raskṛ ta/ /bde sim pa'i bde/ su kha/ tra bra/ dar ba'i bde'ang 'di la'o/ /'od zas bda' spā thu/ zhim pa/ bdug dhū pa/ spos bdug /bda' ded bdag pos pa ti/ bda' 'ded pa/ zhing bdas/ /bder su ga ta/ gshegs bde legs bden bden te la yus te zer/ mad pa'ang zer/ pa bdar/ /gzhu bdungs bdog pa'i skyel skyel gla/ dar bdog swaḥyod pa/ /bden gnyis sa t+ya/ bdud a mṛ ta/ rtsi phye mar bdar/ bcad pa'am gzhogs pa/ /phyag bdar phyag bdar zhes pa byi dor gyi ming dang / phyag dar zhes pa phyag snyogs/ phyi bdar bas 'phul da'o/ /mda' nyag phran/ sha ra/ mdung kun+ta/ mde'u lam mdo'i mdos/ /mdun dog la'ang zer/ pu raskri ta/ mdongs ti la ka mdog bar+ṇa/ mdangs o dza/ mdor saṃ k+ṣip+ta/ bsdus gsung rab/ mdo/ sū tra/ /mdang sang mdongs 'dun pa'i rang shes kyis srog snying phul ba lta bu'o/ /gsol ra mda' dang / /mig mdongs an+dha/ ltongs kyang 'thad par gsungs/ mdud pa dran+tha/ me mdag dang / phu mda' dang / mdan pa'ang rung bar bshad do/ /mas 'phul da'o/ /mya ngan 'da' 'das 'dun ts+tshan+da/ pas 'dud/ na maḥ /'dam paṅka / khrod 'dur 'dur 'dom bya dzā na/ bor ba'i/ zhing 'dug ni ṣaṇ+ṭa/ /'dom sa mā ga ma/ 'dzom pa'i/ dus rjes 'ded gsol 'debs a dh+ye ṣ+ṇa/

'don/ /lha 'dre pi shā tsa/ shing 'dud khung bu 'dru/ /'du byed 'dus byas 'dres mi shra/ pa 'dra/ sa mā na/ /'drul pa'i gtam 'dri pa sh+na/ yi ge 'dri/ /'drid bslu ba'i/ cing khrims 'dral srog 'dor be dza na/ 'dar/ tha ra/ /'degs pa do la/ 'dam 'dod iṣ+ṭa/ 'dul bas 'dul/ / bi na ya/ /'dam bu'i 'dab mar 'dab chags 'du/ /ri 'dabs 'dol sar 'dag gu 'dag /blo 'drog zhabs 'dred 'drad cing 'dul/ /'dreg mkhan 'deng 'dong ba dang 'gro ba/ phyir 'do rta 'dam/ /'dren nā ya ka pas chos 'doms sa mā ga ma/ dge 'dun 'dus/ /'do med 'doms su 'dom gang 'dogs/ bi na ya/ /'dod chags 'du shes 'du 'dzir 'dris/ /'das a tī nya/ po'i 'dad kyis 'khor 'das 'dums/ /ming 'dogs chu 'dal skyo ma 'dal/ /'dag chal gong 'dun sna tshogs lam gang mos/ de ma 'drog /dri ma 'dag 'o na zhes pa'i don 'di ni zhes pa dang / rngul ba'i 'drul sogs/ sogs 'as 'phul da'o/ /grong rdal dza na pa da/ thog rdig rdo rje'i rdul/ a na ra dza/ /rdo rje badz+ra/ rdog po rdeg kyang rdugs/ /rdung 'tshog pheb rdob smra rgyan na pheg rdog ces snang / cha lang rdeb/ /blo rdeb rdab 'chal lus rdos che/ /lag rdum glo rdol dbu ba rdos/ /gri rdor rdol chos rar sa rdo sogs/ btags da'o/ /mkha' ga ru ṭa/ lding 'brug ldir ldab ldib skad/ /lda dā ma/ ldi lde kuñdzi ka mig yod pa'i ldan/ bā na/ /mgo ldog lto ldir ldur ldur ldugs/ lugs/ /seng kha dir/ ldeng ldem ldem lder bzo'i smra rgyan na lder tsho zhes snang / ldebs/ /ldong ros ngad ldang lde gu byugs/ /'jug ldog ldob shes sla ba'i ming / rkyen phyir mi a nā bṛt+ti/ ldog /skom ldud me lde ming gi lde/

/ldum ra'i ldum bu ldab ldob dang / /bcom ldan ldem za ma tog las drang min ldem dang / ldem dgongs gnyis gcig pa lta bur bshad/ drang po yin pa ma bshad/ dgongs a bhi san+dhi/ dris lan ldon/ le'u glon yang zer/ /skyor ldab nyi ldab lhag ma ldas/ las/ /ldan pa'i mdan pa'ang rung / so ldeg mig kyang ldongs/ mdongs kyang rung / don long ba la zer/ /ne ldang ldom bu zas kyi ro snyom/ stan las ldang / ut+thā na/ /ldang tshad la sogs 'khom pa'i ldang dang / ltung ba las ldang ba/ lar btags da'o/ /zhe sdang dra ṣa/ sdang mig sdigs tardza nī/ mdzub sdig /sdar ma bde sdug bsngal/ duḥkha/ dge sdig pā pa/ sdom/ /sdings kyi sdong po dru ma/ sdong bu'i stamā/ sde/ se nā/ /srog dang sdo zhing sde ba gar/ tshan sdeb/ phyogs gcig /srog chags sdom sdig brish+tsi ka sder mo rno/ /sdom sam+bā ra/ pa bsrung sdom sdod ma/ nas sdod/ /sdeb sbyor ts+tshan+da/ mdzes sdug kan+ta/ nor sogs sdu/ 'dis mtshon nas sdud thams cad ma 'ongs pa yin pas sngon 'jug med/ /sdum par khyim/ mchod sdong stamā/ sdong bus bskor/ /sder ma'i na khī/ thug sdor lag pas sdom/ /bka' sdod sde dpon sar btags da'o/ /gri brdar brdeg 'gyel ba/ chos brdung bya rnam rtog gi mgo bo sogs/ brdungs/ /kha brdar bla zlab chol/ brdol chal brdab brdabs/ /rnga brdungs bro brdung go byed brda/ saṅke ta/ /chal mar brdal nas brdul g.yab brdul lta bu/ zhing brdeg mtshon brdeg pa sogs/ /bas 'phul ra mgo ldan da 'o/ /bldabs nas bldag pa bldag cing bldad/ zhib mor skyugs brdad byed pa/ /bas 'phul la mgo ldan da'o/ /bsdu bya bsdu sa mā sa/ bsdus bsdur nas bsdad/ ni ṣaṇ+ṭha/

/nyes bsdams bsdoms piṇ+ṭi ta/ nas srog dang bsdos/ /'og sta gon/ bsdogs sta gon/ sā man+ta/ nyer sā man+ta/ bsam gtan/ bsdogs gzhan la bsdigs/ tardzi ta/ /grogs dang bsdongs bsdebs sna thag bsdogs/ /'gal bsdum mkhan lta bu dang / bsdums bas 'phul sar smra rgyan las sos gdal dang / sos bsdal dpyad byar gsungs pas dpyod dgos rgyu/ btags da'o/ /phan gnod gnas skabs gnang saṃ bri ta/ bkag gnad/ marma/ /gnod yak+ṣa/ sbyin gnag phyugs gnam khaṃ/ ltar gnag kriṣ+ṇa/ /gnas gtan nyer gnas gnas s+d+yā na/ khang gnas/ ga ti/ /gnod a ba kā ra/ byed zil a bh-i bhū ya/ gnon gna' pu ra ṇa/ thog ma'i sngon/ mi gnubs/ gna'o zhes pa 'ang de ka /zhi gnas gnas 'gyur gnas lugs rtogs/ /gnangs bzhes gang rung la/ gnam ra gzhu/ ru rkang pas gnon/ /zhe gnong durmaṅku / nyes pa khas mi len pa'i don gnong mi bskur ba'ang / gnad gcod gnas ngan len/ /gnod gnas la sogs gnag sems/ gas 'phul na'o/ /mnal sulta/ gzims mna' ma 'og tu mnan/ ā krān+ta/ /mnabs rtsal kha zas/ dri mnam mnar a bī tsi/ med mnar/ bī tsi/ /mnar sems zas mnog mnog khyer chung ba/ chung ba/ /mnon ri mna' sha pa tha/ skyal na bza' mnabs/ gyon pa/ /mno bsam ā sha mnos bsam pa/ sogs mas 'phul na'o/ /rnam shes rnon po'i rnal 'byor yo ga rnams/ /rnam yol ba'ang zer/ rtog rnam grangs rnam pa mang / /rna shro tra/ shog rtse dī k+ṣ+ṇa/ rno rnal ma'i ma bcos pa/ don/ /khugs rna rnag pū ri/ khrag zhing snang ma/ /tshig phrad rnam bi/ par rar rna rgyan sogs/ de la gya tho'ang zer/ btags na'o/ /snar ma snron dz+yaṣ+ṭhā/ snrubs mū la/ snag ma si/

tsha snur/ /snang ba a ba bha sa/ sna tshogs nā nā/ sna nā sa/ yi snabs/ siṅgha na/ /snam bu'i pa ṭa/ snam saṃ gha ṭa/ sbyar snal ring cha/ ba'i sna/ nā sa/ /bar snang snang gsal snum tai la/ dri snom/ /lam snar sna gtso bo/ bo'i snag rus ma yin pa/ dbon snang / /ltar snang sna mang snrel mdo sde sa bcu pa'i 'grel ba las snrel gzhi'i don 'chol ba'am go rim du mi gnas pa la bshad ces smra rgyan las gsungs/ snrel gzhi'i 'jig rten zhes pa logs la rkang gis 'gro ba la bshad pa'i skabs kyang yod par snang / gzhi phred/ /yug snam snam me tog phran sna mdo sne'u/ sngo / /snad skyon gyi/ yar ser sna'i snon rla bsnyan 'ang zer/ mar snoms/ /snam rgyab kyi don/ zur la'ang 'jug logs sa la btags pa'i na'o/ snod spyad sogs kyang de la yol go'ang zer yang phyis su yang zer/ /brnab sems lto la brnan 'chang ba'i don/ yang brnangs/ zas kyis gre bar/ /brnag bzod dka'/ smra rgyan las mnag dka' zhes bshad mod/ dka'i brnags pas bsam pas sran pa'am bzod pa/ mdun du brgyu/ 'then pa/ /sbas pa'i brnogs bsdams pa/ dang nges bzung brnan/ nges bzung ste dbu ma bden gnyis kyi 'grel pa las ni zhes pa ni brnan pa'i don to zhes pa lta bu/ /bas 'phul ra bsam pa'i don brnag pa'ang yin te bkas bcad chen mo las rang gi brnag pa rdzogs par bya phyir dang zhes gsungs pas so/ /mgo ldan na'o/ /gnad marmā ha ta/ bsnun mtshon bsnun shastā ha ta/ nu ma bsnun/ /srol bsnubs brnubs zhes kyang 'thad par gsungs/ gong 'og bsnor zhing bsnol/ /mtshon bsnams phyag tu/ dhṛ ta/ dus bsnur zhib mor bsnur/ /mjug bsnar dri bsnams nem nem bsnems/ /mang du bsnan nas 'dres mar bsnos/

/bas 'phul sa smra rgyan las mgo bo bsnar ba'ang 'di rang bshad/ mgo ldan na'o/ /pang ut+saṅga / par par pā ṭa/ bu be'u/ pi wang bī na/ 'dzin/ /gcig e ka bur pir gyis pa tra bris/ /pu mda' yab/ kra ma shīr+ṣa/ shu'i pu shud pya/ pir gyi phur/ /puṇ+ḍa ri ka pi pi ling / /pa shi bod kyi btsun pa rgya nag tu phyin pa'i ming / pad+ma pa la sha /pus btsugs pog spos kyi brda rnying / phor de'i snod/ ga pur 'thul/ /par dpe cha/ ma'i bo ti pusta ka zur chag paṇ+ḍi mkhas pa'am byang ba/ ta/ /ze prog prog sen mo'i brda rnying / prog zhu 'og ska rags kyi rgyan 'phyang ba'i tshar tshar de yin par smra rgyan las kyang bshad lar stag lpags kyi sham thabs lta bu la'ang 'jug rung ba 'dra/ pag dang / /pur khang par btang po ṭa la/ /pu pa la dang pu shel tsi/ /pa sangs shu kra pra pra se na/ phab bri yang ku/ /pags tsarma/ gzhan la lpags dang / drug sgra yod pa dang / gzhi dang ma 'brel ba la pa pa rkyang ngo / /pags pa ni zhes pa lta bu gzhi med pa/ stag gi pags pa lta bu zhes pa drug sgra can/ pa lag lag tshan gyi don/ pod po de yang po tho yang zer ba grong tshig bzos kyang / /par gyi 'phar sogs pa rkyang ngo / /dpag tshad rjes a nu mū na/ dpag dpag bya me ya/ dpog mā na/ /rgyal po'i dpya daṇ+ḍa/ khral dpyang thag dpyangs/ /dpag pa ra mi ta/ med dmag dpung tsakra/ dpung pu chung / /dper tad+ya thā pi nā ma/ na dpe a nu byañdza na/ byad dpe pusta ka cha dben/ / mi rtag pa nyid kyi mdo sogs las 'phangs pa dang yid du 'ong ba sogs kyi don du bshad cing mkho ba'ang / /rnam dpyod bi tsā ra/ rtog dpyod brtag pa rīk+ṣa na/ dpyad dang / /rje pa ti/ dpon slob dpon sems satwa/

dpa' che/ /dpyid sa ban+ta/ dus dpral ba dpyi kuk+ṣi/ mgo dpyongs/ /shing nga dge slong ma'i gos kyi bye brag go /dpung bcad dpung ba hu/ rgyan ke yū ra/ dang / /dar dpyang dpangs mtho dpag bsam shing / /dpa' bo bī ra/ dpa' ba'i ba gha/ dpang sāk+ṣi/ pos dpod/ /gos dpyad dpyis mthar phyin pa'am gting phyin pa yin la/ de la cis phyin kyang rung / rtser phyims/ phyin dpyas mi 'dogs/ /dpal shrī mān/ ldan dpang lo das 'phul lo/ /pha spad spun bhā ta/ zla spang ha ya/ bya spangs/ pra hī ṇa/ /sprang po'i da ri dra/ spar mor spa dbyug sprad/ ar+pi ta/ /spos dhu pa/ sprin ma gha/ spro spros pra muñtsa/ longs spyod bho ga spyad/ /spang spos spar me/ spor gong du/ spen ma/ spyil po/ ku ṭā+ai/ spro/ ut+sā ha/ sems spro/ /spen phul+la/ rgyan can/ tog spug rin chen/ karke ta na/ gis spud rgyan pa/ pas spa/ byin chags pa'i don te g.yul du dpa' mdang ma 'dres par bya/ /gnas spar bya spur gzhan du spags/ /mgo ro ma/ spu sprug sprug thags kyi spun/ /spe'u yi gces spras spyad dngos spel/ /spa ma shing spa dog spru sngo/ sman/ ma spra ba spungs/ /spra 'gyur byed zer/ chal spod sga g.yer sogs kyi/ dang zho spris spags/ /'thab mo sprad sprod gshe ba'am sdigs pa dang khros pa/ pa rī bhā ṣa/ spyos nas spyugs/ /spyi sa mā n+ya/ dgos spel mar 'phrin spring springs/ /mun sprul spong spongs spyod mu stegs kyi bye brag tsa ri ka pa pa/ /tshur spyon ā gats+tsha/ 'bod pa'i brda 'di kho na/ yang byor zhes pa 'das pa sogs skabs gzhan ston pa'o/ /dka' spyad chos spyod spor/ /spros bral sprul nirma ṇa/

pa gza' spen sha naish+tsa ra/ pa/ /gos spo char spyings bying du bcug pa'i don de gru spyings dang / shan spyings sogs kyang de bzhin no/ /spra tshil spyin/ 'byar byed/ /khe spog bar spogs sogs kyang / spyang spyang khu grong tshig ki spra spre'u/ marka ṭa/ /spyang rig pa/ po'i spobs pra ti bhā na/ pas dge mi dge ba ngom pa'am bdag bstod mi byed pa/ spyoms/ ut+kar+ṣa/ /spyi ka ra ka blugs kha spubs rgyan gyis spras/ /spyi shi raḥ bo'i spabs rdul gyis/ dang spu la bab/ rung ba'i don yin cing / de la spus brtag pa dang spus phab pa zer/ spyod pa spa bkong mtho ba'i spo/ /mig gi spyan sogs ne tra/ spang gshongs dang / spa mkhar/ lce spyang la/ sar zad pa'i sprug pa dang / rtse sa'i spong sa sogs kyang / btags pa'o/ /stag gzhi dang 'brel ba/ lpags mi lpags/ gzig lpags sogs/ gzhi dang ma 'brel ba'i pags pa ni zhes pa lta bu dang drug sgra yod pa'i stag gi pags pa/ mi yi pags pa sogs la pa rkyang byed pa mkhas pa rnams kyi phyag bzhes su bstar ba'i bkar snang ngo / /la sogs lar btags pa'o/ /phang par phun tshogs phun tshugs shing / /phrug gu po ta/ dang sprad rdul phran phra/ /brgya sha ta/ phrag phyang rgyan nam spud pa/ phrul phyal grong pa zhe sa/ phyang k+ṣā ma/ 'jo le/ nge / /phyug po'i phyir du phyogs go bcur di shi laṃ di ka phyin/ i tā/ /phyag phyags snyogs/ paṃ shu/ dar phyi pī ṭa/ sa'i mi gtsang ba bshang ba/ phye tsār+ṇa/ ma phyed/ ar+dha/ /phywa mkhan phongs pas phying rul phyar/ /phyis bdar phyis nas phyags mas phyags/ /nam phyed phyen thong phyi dro yang / /dbang phyug dgugs phyung sgo phye nas/ /phyags lham phran k+ṣu dra/ tshegs phreng ba mā la phrogs/ ha ra/

/phra men phrin phyang sar yang zer/ kār+ya/ /las sa spyod che/ /phyugs ā ḍhā/ kyi spru mngal gyis/ ma phye ma leb/ /phru go la/ khog ma/ ba'i phyir phyung phyag pā ṇi/ gis khyor/ /smin phrag phyag na mo/ 'tshal nyin mtshan rgyun du'i don/ phyed/ /phra ma pi shu na/ phrag ir+ṣ+ya/ dog phrag skan+da/ so phral/ so sor/ /phyin chad yid phyung sun ci rang gis rang sun 'byin pa/ phyin/ /ma pham tshig phrad rnam dbye phyed/ go ba/ /phyi chung ma/ 'bring phyir phyogs phyin ci log /phru ma dmag sgar/ phyar rnam g.yeng / g.yeng pha rkyang ngo / /gzhan la 'phya smod pa/ 'phyes 'od a ba bha/ 'phro 'phros/ /'phyi ba sgom chen/ 'phye gong bu'am lto bas 'gro ba'i don/ bo rkang med / 'phyi pañtsi ma/ dus 'phyis/ /rnam bi kurba ṇa/ 'phrul sgyu 'phrul mda' 'phen 'phangs/ /na 'phang khri 'phang go 'phang 'phrog ha ra/ /mtsho 'phyur dhū ma ya ti/ dud 'phyur lam 'phyug ching 'phyugs/ /snying 'phyo 'phyon mas phye 'phyar 'phangs/ chud zos pa'i don/ /'phongs tshang ra'i/ kyi 'phag 'phag mgo thums 'phur/ /'phong mda'am nyag phran/ gis gzhan 'pham 'phal 'di la ra btags byed pa grong tshig kha 'grig /'phyan zhing yan pa'am 'khyams pa/ 'phyo lding ba/ lding dar 'phyar 'phral/ /'phrin le ba/ 'phrod 'ching 'phras sems la 'phrang / /'phral ba dpral ba/ skra 'phyings phyag dar 'phyag phyags snyigs/ paṃ shu/ /'phyang a ba la bi na/ thur du/ dang 'phye ba 'du 'phrod sogs/ lto 'phye/ u raṅka / /'a yis 'phul ba'i pha nyid do/ /bla na ut+ta ra/ phyi ma la'ang / ma'i gu ru'am/ bla steng na'am/ gong na/ bi tā na/ bla bre bres/ /byams mai tra ya'am mai tri/ pas byad byur mya ngan/

byabs a sa na ya/ pas byer/ /bre 'jal byed/ yi pi ṭa ka bye bā lu kā/ mas brabs pas byang / /bran dā sa/ g.yog byes byon byug le sa/ pa byin/ /byis bus pa zer/ bā la/ pas bya ra'i spyan pa'ang zer/ byang sems byon/ /bram ze brag she la/ ri'i byang at+ta ra/ du byol/ /bya dī dza/ byi'u byib byi bi rā la/ la'i byad/ /byol tir+ya ka song u ra ga brang u ra ga 'gro'i brang byil byil/ /bla steng g.yogs pa thob phub pa sogs/ gab bla gos ut+ta ra saṅga / blus kyang bla/ rgyu chog bzod ces pa'i don yin/ /blun po dza ṭa/ 'dam bying mag+na/ blo blong blong / yi mug pa'am rig pa mi gsal ba ste yid rmugs pa/ /bro glā na/ nad kyi brda/ nad thabs a se ta/ bral bro mna' skyal ba'i ming yin/ sha pa pa/ bor bros/ /byan nang byan g.yog yin/ de la rtse rgod dang lha 'bangs kyang zer/ mo byi dor rang byan dbang du gyur pa/ chud/ /byag mkhan bro zlos gar/ nā ṭa/ gar bye bas brel/ /sos blad chu blud zas brims brod/ /bya na'i tshod ma la sogs zas kyi spags ma rgya ri'i don/ yo byad byur bur blugs/ /da byid gangs sbal/ ro bro bra ba'i brun/ /dong brubs khol ba'am rba klong / chu na dī pū ra/ brub bru k+ṣu dha/ ltogs pa/ ba tsha/ /gos byer btso tshos/ blag gos kyis byibs/ /bla tshe byang bur ba bla byug yugs kyang zer/ /khas blang bla thabs sa blas byed/ /blo brid bla a dhi ba tsa na/ dag yi li khi ti/ ger bris/ zin bris kyang ngo / de la zig kyang zer/ /spu byi cha byad gzi byin bri/ /byi bzhin bra nye bra phye byod/ /byug gral gyi ming / ris bya ba'i bye brag la/ /rgyal ra dza/

blon pa ri ṇa ga ya/ blo mig bde nges par zhes pa'i the tshom med pa'am/ thabs zab mos zhes bya ba'i don du bzung ngo / /blag su kha/ byed/ /bla dor blon 'debs zur shes gros 'debs dang chos ston pa'ang zer/ bla bo la/ /rab byung skra bregs rna ba blags/ rna ba gtod pa'i don/ /lta gos brang breng bya dgar byin/ /sman bhai ṣa dz+ya gu ru/ bla byang chub bla na a nut+ta ra/ med/ /byin a dhiṣ+ṭhā na/ rlabs byu dru ma/ ru ba rkyang ngo / / spyi blugs dang / mthar brun/ byi dang / byi mo sogs kyang ngo / /dbyen dang dbyen bhe da ka bral chos dharma dha du/ dbyings dbyibs/ yibs kyang zer/ /dbyer med dpung pa dpung madh+ya/ dang dbus/ /dbyug chu tshod dam shing bu/ ber ka'i rigs/ gu dbyig pa dbyug pa dbyug /rdzing dbol chu dbo 'bo ba'i don pho zhes pa'o/ /skar ma dbo/ ut+ta ra phalgu na/ /phyis ut+sardza na/ dbyung sun dbyung mtshon gyis dbug bidh+yaṃ phug pa/ /dbul da ri dra/ po dpung shwā sa/ dbyung nor mi dbrog mi 'phrog pa/ /tshon gyi dbyig mor dbyi dbyig dbur/ /dbon pos dbyangs swa ra/ dbul nir+yā ta/ sma mi dbab/ /dbyig ba su/ gnyen dbu ma ma dh+ya/ gdugs kyang dbub/ phub pa'i don/ /dbang bskur a bhi ṣiñtsa/ byin dbab ā be sha gtan la dbab/ /lung 'bog 'bog pa/ 'khur dbog 'bog dben par dbral/ / phral ba'i don/ i shwa ra/ dbang phyug dbang ldan dbang thang skal ba'am bzang ba/ dbyar/ nam zla/ /dbang po in+d+ra/ dbyig nor mang / mang dpral dbyes che/ /dpa' rlabs un+mi/ dbu lbu ba pe ṇa/ ba skyon gyi dbags/ /dbre btsog kha dbri zhe sa'i dpa'/ /dbal ke tu/ rta'i dbal bzang ngan lta bu/

phur pa dang / me'i dbal sogs/ ni sha nyams rtse drod tog /zha nye'i dbyar snod kyi stegs/ 'dabs das 'phul ba'o/ mgo bo'i dbu dang / gcan gzan dbyi sogs dang / rta dbad nas btang ba sogs kyang ngo / /rab 'byams pra sa ri ta/ 'byams klas 'byung bzhi 'brug mai gha swa ra/ /'bral a ba ga ta/ med dang 'brel sa m+ban+dha/ 'bras bu 'bru/ tā ya na/ /'bring ma dh+ya ma/ po 'dam 'bying 'brum kāṇ+ḍa ka nad 'byang / /'brog gi 'bri tsa ma rī/ 'bring tsa ma ra/ rus kyi 'brom/ /'byung bha bi ta 'gyur tshe 'byid 'gred pa'i 'byid/ /skra 'bal 'bel gtam yang dag pa'i gtam/ gtam sgo 'byed/ ud+gha ṭa na/ /'bras chan lces 'byogs chang 'byo 'byangs/ lto 'khru ba ste 'byams pa byas na nor/ /'brom rus kyi/ ston 'byon dus 'bros shing 'brang / rjes su/ a nu sa ra/ /'brub khung kha 'byed 'byol zhing 'byer/ pha la ya/ /mtshang 'bru'i tshig 'byin tshon 'byug 'byongs/ /kha 'bri chu 'brus sbyar ba'i 'byar/ ram shag kyang zer/ zhabs 'bring / zha 'bring gnyis kyang ngo / /'byung po'i 'byor pa 'as nyams pa'i don 'bags pa dang / bde bar brten pa'i brda 'brongs pa sogs kyang ngo / /'phul ba'o/ /khyi rbad rbab sgril kha rbad cheng / /rba klong skya rbab skra rbad rbod/ /rbod ma rkyel sogs rgyud ma rdeg rbangs ma gtong sogs/ rar btags ba'o/ /lbu dbu ba dang rnam grangs/ phe ṇa/ ba lba ba skye'i/ ga la gaṇ+ḍa/ ba lar btags/ smra rgyan du lto sbos pa dang skya lbab la'ang 'di bshad do/ /nor dha ra na/ sbyin gnod yak+ṣa/ sbyin sbyin dā na pa ti/ bdag sbron/ /sbun tu ṣa/ shun pa/ pa sbangs dang sbangs mas sbengs/ /sbug tu nor sba sbas gup+ta/ sbos sbed/ go pa na/ /nyis sbrags sbra pañdza ra/

'bubs sbrel nas sbyar/ pu ṭa/ /sbres na sbur mas me sbar sbor/ /chu sbrus zan sbrus phyogs gcig sbams/ /sbrum ma lto sbos dbos pa'ang zer/ srog chags sbre/ /phyag sbal grog sbur sbal pa karka ṭa/ sbrul/ sar+pa/ /grogs sbran sbungs bskyed sbud pa'i sbungs/ /sbyag por sbyib cing sbe 'dzing kha kha sbyong / /sbyag tshe lus sbrin sba mkhar sbom/ s+d+yū la/ /sha sbrang sbrang bh+ra ma ra/ ma sbrang ma dhu/ dang sbrags/ /sbed rdo'i ming / byed gser sbram sa le su bar+ṇa/ sbram/ /sbyor ba yo ga sbyang bya sbyong byed sbyangs/ /dge sbyong shra ma ṇa/ gso sbyongs po ṣa dha/ gtsang shu tsi/ sbra sbyor/ /'doms kyi sba ba gu h+ya/ sbubs dang gsal ba'i sbrid pa sogs/ dngos ngan pa'i sha chung ba la sbags pa zer ba/ nā la/ khung bu'i yin/ 'gram pa'i lpags kyang ngo / /sar btags ba'o/ /ro myags myag myog nags myul myur/ tūr+ṇa/ /myang 'das myang myang myug myug dang / /mya ngan mya chu med pa'am/ ngam myu gu aṅku ra/ myos/ mat+ta /myong bā+e dā na/ bde ba myong / bas myags rul ba/ pa'i ro ma a swā du/ myang / /mya nirbā ṇa/ ngan 'das sogs ma rkyang ngo / /dmag se nā/ gi nyes dmigs dmangs shru dra/ rigs dman/ /dme bo rus gcig pa gsod pa po/ dmus an+dha/ long dmigs bu long khrid/ med/ /dmu rgod dmu chu 'dre srin dmu/ /blo blun pa/ dmun dmus tshi chad pa'i don de yi chad la'ang / byung bu ga'i dmig /gtsang dme smra rgyan du sa mgo can dgos par gsungs so/ /'dzum dmul pra ha si ta/ dmigs pa gtod/ /lag khag khur ba'i don/ dmar kha kha gsal dmar kha dog dmar/ rak+ta/ /nyams dmas dmod dmod mo la rngad mo'am zer/

btsugs dmod dma' mor smod yang don mi gcig pa 'dor/ /dmyal na ra ka ba gnas dma' phra mo ma yin pa'i don mod mi dma' zer ba dang / a pa ma na/ dmigs bsal dang / /myung myug dmyugs mdo tshangs pa'i dra ba sogs mang por 'byung / sogs das phul ma'o/ /rmad ud+bhu ta/ byung rmugs 'dzin dzam+bha la/ rmang lam zer/ swab+na/ rmi lam rmis/ /rmang nyen yang zer/ nas 'grim gyi rmang sogs/ rmo zhing la/ rmos rmon dor dang / /rmongs glos pa'ang zer/ mūr+kha/ rmugs par byed/ dzam+bha na/ khyis rmur rmugs dzam+bha ya/ pa'i rma/ sra na/ /rmen pa rta rmig khya ra/ gong sga'i/ rmed rmus/ sun pa'i dmus/ /rmongs spu rmeg gtan med pa/ med las smon 'di smra rgyan las bshad/ langs/ /ser rme bsris rma ngo mtshar rmad/ ar+gha ta/ /rmo rmo bal rmel dris pa'i rmas/ pra sh+na/ smras pa'i brda/ /rma bya khams gnyid kyis/ rmya bya rmyang byed/ /rmog dang ya lad ces pa spyir go cha dang skabs kyis rmog la 'jug pa'ang yod par gsungs/ dbu rmog dbu 'phang / rar btags ma'o/ /sman o ṣa dhi/ dang sman pa'i bhi ṣaka phan pa'i sman pa/ gtam smra uk+ta/ smros/ /smig ma rī tsi/ rgyu smag an+dha kā ra/ mun pa'i ming / rum zong min mor/ /sman ljongs sug smel smyag smya ga shad yin nam snyam/ shad dang / /smyug bang+sha / ma smyi yi ge'i/ gu smyig yi ge'i/ ma smin/ bi pā ka /tshe smad at+ta ra/ sma phab smad ras smod/ nin+da/ /mgo smyung chung ba'i don/ smrang smra tshig ni gsang tshig dang smra ba tsam la'ang 'jug par gsungs la smra ba la smreng ba zhes pa'ang snang / dang smre sngags smras/ /bu smad ming smos smyan bag ma'i gnyen ka

ka byed/ /ngur ka ṣa/ smrig dmar ser te snyigs mas 'tshos pa'i don yin par gsungs/ rnam smin smos ci dgos/ /smyung gnas u ṣi ta/ dus smyur smyon pa smyo/ un+mā da/ /smon 'drin grogs po/ dri smed gsol ba'am/ deng sang 'dri smed zer ba de'o/ smon lam pra ṇi bhi/ sman/ nog la phan pa'i don/ /smin drug kṛ t+ti kā/ smal po mṛ ge shi ra/ smin drug kārti ke ya/ bu/ /sme ba ti la ka smug rtsi kha dog smug /sma ra shram shru/ smin bh+rū/ ma rme sha can/ /rtsis kyi rme ba sar nyams pa'i sbas pa sogs/ btags ma'o/ /tsab tsub mi bya tsog tsog ut+ku ṭu ka pu/ /tsan+da tsu ta tsam pa ka /tsa ko ra dang tsi ti mo/ /ne bya/ tso shu ka de tsam tat+mā tra/ de tsugs lags/ /tsen ne tser tser tsa re ba/ /tsā ru'i mchod pa'i bye brag bza' ba tsa na ka /tsug tsug zas za dus kha'i/ sgra sogs tsa rkyang ngo / /gtsug spyi tor zer/ uṣ+ṇī ṣa/ tor spyi mūd+dha/ gtsug gtsang kū ṭa/ khang gtsang / sa gtsang ba lta bu/ /mi gtsigs mi rigs pa/ spyod pa gtsug ar+ṣa/ bi hā ra/ sde snod/ lag khang / /gtsod rus gtsod ra/ gtses shing gtser bas gtser/ /mche gtsigs ka rā la/ gtsub shing gtsug stan gtsubs/ smra rgyan du gtan zer ba snang / /gtso bo pra dhā na/ gtsigs ngag sgron na gtsis zer ba snang / don la thugs gtsigs dang spyi gtsigs sogs/ che gtsags smra rgyan du ma 'phul kho na bshad snang / bus gtsags/ bas 'phul/ /gtsang smra rgyan du ra mgo mdzad snang / snā ta/ phyogs gtsang chu gas 'phul tsa'o/ /btsan po srong btsan lde btsan sogs/ bka' btsan rdzong btsan dang / /btsun yo ṣa ta/ mor bu bcas grub btsas btsal/ gzhan nas/ bar+ye ṣi ta/

/btsun ban+de/ pa mig btsum btson sgo ra zer/ rar btsud/ /btsong kun dang zer/ smra rgyan du tsa rkyang mdzad snang / gairka/ btsugs btsag btsongs krī ta/ btsod mañdziṣ+ṭha/ mdog la ja hong / btso btsos/ pañdzi ta/ /btsan dug tshags kyis btsags shing btsir/ pī ḍa/ /btsas khyer lcags kyi/ 'phags btsog btso blag ra ja ka tshos mkhan/ mkhan/ /mtho btsams brdeg btsog btsog pho btsog go po brdeg /btsan rgod 'dre/ btsan thabs gser btso tap+ta/ ma/ /btsad po btsas ma bas gos btsems dang ba glang btsos dang mig gis btsos sogs/ 'phul tsa'o/ /rtsa ban+dhu/ lag gnyen rtsa ba/ mū la/ rtse mo/ a gra/ tshon raṅga / rtsi rtsing / s+d+yū la/ /tsi mar rtsi shing rtsi tog rtswa/ tri ṇa/ /'thab rtsod pra bā da/ rtsed mo rtse krī ḍa na/ rtses krī ḍi ta/ rtsen/ rol ba'am rtse ba/ /lngas rtsen sum lha gnas/ rtsen rtsis byed/ rtsis mkhan/ ga ṇi ka /rtsib pārashwa/ ma'i rtsa nā ṭa/ rgyus rtsid tsa ma ra ro ma/ pa rtsub/ pa ru ṣa/ /kha rtsang kha sang grong tshig rtse g.yog rgod rtsam ring rtsegs/ /rtsabs rtsod rtsad gcod atakhā ta/ gcod tsher ma'i rtsangs/ /stabs rtsol 'bad rtsol rtsom ā ram+bha na/ pa rtsoms/ shig ā ram+bha ma/ /zho rtsabs rtsab mo ser rtsa'i gos/ /rtsig pa rtsigs mkhar 'khor lo'i rtsibs/ ā ra/ /rtsangs srog chags/ pa srog rung / rtsol rar stobs kyi rtsal dang zong la rtseg rtseg byed pa bdud rtsi sogs kyang ngo / /pa ra kra ma/ btags tsa'o/ /bka' stsal ā ha/ dngos grub stsal pra yats+tsha/ dang stsol/ /sbyin pa stsal de yaṃ/ bgyi bgyid du stsal/ /stsal pra yats+tsha/ du gsol sogs sar btags tsa'o/ /brtson bīr+ya/

bstun pa dang 'bras bu 'bogs kyang zer/ 'grus snying brtse da ya/ brtse ba a nu kam+pa/ can/ /brtsad cing dris nas brtsams bya brtsams/ ā ram+bha/ /khang kū ḍā gā ra/ brtsegs brtsigs shing brtsi ga ṇi ta/ bya brtsis/ /so so brtsed pa'i don yin pa 'dra/ brtse ha cang 'di la ba 'phul med pa'ang 'thad par gsungs/ brtsengs ut+kṛṣ+ṭa/ pa'i gos/ /bas 'phul ra smra rgyan du mi gtsang btsog dang bgyid brtsal dang brtsal ma thag sogs dang / thar pa'i brtsan sa dang / gru brtsas sogs la'ang brda 'di bzhin du mdzad snang mod/ rang lugs su bzung bar mi bya'o/ /mgo can tsa'o/ /nags ba na/ tshal skyed tshal upyā na/ tshi gu'i tshigs/ smyugs tshigs lta bu/ skyogs los 'bru'i snying po la bshad/ /tshogs sa mā dza/ 'dun pa'ang zer/ pa'i sde garga/ tshan lang yu ba na/ tsho dang / /tshon rtsi phra tshoms tshar du dngar/ gral gyi don/ /the tshom tsham rngam 'jigs sdang / 'ju byed tshwa/ spyir tshwa zer dus wa zur dang / lan tsha sogs la med pa mkhas pa'i brda'o/ /khang pa'i tshoms sngo'i tshod ma/ byañdza na/ sogs tsha rkyang ngo / /ngo āsh+tshar+ya/ mtshar mtshan dpe mtsho sa ra/ dang mtshe'u/ alpa sa ra/ /mtshe lhan cig tu skyes pa'i/ ma mtshams bcad mtshan gzhi dang / /mtshan nyid lak+ṣa ṇa/ mtshon bya mtshan mas mtshan/ /phyogs mtshams skyon mtshang mtshan mo ni sha mtshon/ /mtshur rus ston kha mtshul tuṇ+ḍa/ mtshal hiṅgu / dang mtshungs/ sa mā na/ /rgyal mtshan dh+wa dza/ mtsha' gcan gzan/ mes rta mtsha' rting dkar/ lu/ /mtshar sdug khyim mtshes sdum mtshes kyang zer/ mtshe dang mtshan/ /mtshams med la mtsher dur mchod mtshun/ ka bya/ pha mes kyi/ /mtshon shasatra/ cha'i phyag mtshan mtshogs smra rgyan las 'di la 'as 'phul bshad/

mar 'phyar/ /ming gi mtshan nā ma/ sogs mas 'phul tsha'o/ /blo 'tshabs chu 'tshag nang du 'tshangs/ /til 'tshir pī ḍa na/ me 'tshig du ba 'tshubs/ /zas 'tshed pa tsa ti/ lus 'tsho dzī ba na/ 'tsho bid+ya/ byed 'tshengs/ /'tshe gnod/ he ṭha na/ med 'tshag gos bzang bas yan lag dang nying lag rgyas pa/ bzang 'tshal shes pa/ chog pa/ 'dod pa yod pa sogs/ ma shes pa sogs/ 'tshal/ /nor e ṣa ṇa/ 'tshol phyugs 'tsho rak+ṣi ta/ 'tshog chas tshong du/ 'tshong / krī ta na/ /brdeg 'tshog ka na ti/ la 'tsho 'od 'tsher zhing / /blo dang 'tshams par skyin pa 'tshal/ /gdung 'tshob 'tshang rgya longs pa'i 'tshar/ /phyag 'tshal ba dang chog pa'i 'tshal/ /'dzom pa'i 'tshag sa mā ga sogs zas kyi ming 'tshal la sogs/ 'as 'phul tsha'o/ /dza rag dngul dam gyi bye brag dza lang dza bo shing / /dza dza yag grong tshig ya can sogs dza rkyang ngo / /dpa' mdzangs paṇ+ḍi ta/ mdza' bo'i bang mdzod ke sha mdzes/ ru tsi ra/ /gnod mdzes mdzub mo mdzod spu dkar/ /mdzo sri ma ra/ rta'i mdzer māṃ sa kī la/ pa mdze kuthaṭha/ nad dang / /mdzol bu ri dwags kyi 'dzin thabs/ srung ba'i mdzad pa kār+ya/ mdzod/ ku ru/ /ya rab mdzangs sogs mas 'phul dza'o/ /'dzings pas gos 'dzar a ba sā tha/ lag pas 'dzin/ ga ha ṇa/ /'dzag shwa ba/ dang 'dzir ba'i snod 'dzed 'dzem/ /'dzur gzur ba/ zhing sgor 'dzul 'dzeg ā ro ha/ skas 'dzugs/ /bzhin smi ta/ 'dzum 'dzim pa snod du 'dzud/ /'dzam dzam+bu/ gling du 'dzom sa mā ga ma/ nor 'dzangs k+ṣī ṇa/ mdzad/ /'dzab bzlas dze ba na/ skad 'dzer nor ba'i 'dzol/ bh+rān+ta/ /'du 'dzis sat+sarga/ chud 'dza' rdo yi 'dzang / /'khrugs pa'i 'dzag 'dzog 'as bud med kyi don bgrod bya ste 'dzan mo dang /

skyes pa'i don bgrod byed de 'dzan pho dang / zer ba'i brda 'dzer te sogs/ 'phul dza'o/ /kun rdzob samabṛt+ti/ rdzun mṛ ṣa/ gyi rdzab skyag zog gi rdzus dang / /phyugs rdzi'i rak+ṣa/ rdzongs su rdzi'u byin/ /rdzing dang la'ang zer/ bur paṣ+ka ra/ rdzus skyes u pa pā du ka 'dam rdzog rdzab/ kan+da ma/ /rdzi rlung / phyogs rdza kum+bha/ ma'i nu rdzi nying khu/ dang / /rdzi med rdzi ma mig gi zin pa'i rdzogs/ sa māp+ta/ /mkhar rdzong ko ṭi/ nor rdzas dra bya/ rdzu 'phrul ṛd+dhi/ dang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas 'di rnams ra la dza btags pa kho na yin cing / sa la dza btags pa 'bri mkhan snang yang de ma bshad pas ma dag par rig par bya'o/ /sogs rar btags dza'o/ /gzhan gyis mi brdzi khro bor brdzus/ /ral pa gyen brdzes dbrel pa'ang zer/ srog chags brdzis/ lhog pas/ /zan brdzis yul gzhan brdzangs pa sogs/ /bas 'phul ra brdzun tshig smra ba sogs/ mgo ldan dza 'o/ /wa dzam+bu ka skyes pha wang sga phong / chu'i wa kha /'gi'u wang pi wang 'dzum wang wang / /yid la wa le wa long dang / /wa ta yug sogs wa rkyang ngo // ༈ //zha bo'i phak+ka zhwa khwo la/ mo zha rkyang ngo / /mnyam sa mā pan+na/ gzhag gzhal me yaṃ/ bya gzhal med a me yaṃ/ khang / /kun gzhi'i ā la ya/ rnam bya ba s+d+yā na/ gzhag nam gzhag gtan/ /gzhon ku ma ra/ phyugs phyung zer/ nu gzhung bzang gzha' 'ja' tshon/ in+d+ra yu dha/ tshon gzhu/ dha na/ /gzhogs bslong bdud gzhom sbo gzhogs kyang / /gnas a dha ra/ gzhi gzhong ka ro ṭa/ pa g.yang a dzi na/ gzhi gzhan/ a n+ya/ /mngag g.yog gzhug khu ba gzhibs 'jibs pa dang bsgrigs pa/ las gzhol/ 'bab pa/ /gzha' g.yung drung / gsang gzhongs su ljongs su/

lcag gis gzhu/ /gzhi grub gzhung sa ma ya/ lugs rtag gzhig gzhug /gzhogs kyi lus kyi/ nad gzhi gzhang 'brum gzhil/ nā sha na/ 'joms pa'i don/ /gzhar yang ka da tsi ta/ nam yang dang slar yang / gzhur zur za'i don gzhur brtag kyang ngo / /'od zer can gyi mdor 'byung / med yid me dha/ gzhungs gzhob/ tshig pa'i/ /gzhis ka glu gzhas 'tsho zhing dhṛ yan+te/ sdod pa'am bzhugs pa/ gzhes/ /dran pa nyer smṛ d+yu pa s+d+yā na/ gzhag bsgrigs pa'i gzhibs/ /gzhen gzhon bde bas kyang zer/ don la dran bskul/ bskul nang gzhug gas lus kyi gzhang dang gzhal bya dang dgra bo gzhom sogs kyang / 'phul zha'o/ /bzhag zin bzhad ha si ti/ bgad ga zha'ang zer/ bzhad dkar bzhi/ /bzhabs nas skra bzhar gzham dran bskul/ sgo phyed/ /gsol bzhi'i dgongs bzhed ma da/ de bzhin ta tha tā/ nyid/ /bzhengs ut+thi ta/ bzhugs ā sī na/ 'byon bzhud ga ta/ bzhon yā na/ rta sogs/ pa bzhon/ zhon pa/ /bzhon ma zho bzhos dhe nu/ brlan bzha' aradra/ bzhogs/ /g.yog bzhun mar bzhu bzhur nas bzhes/ bhuk+ta/ /bzhin mu kha/ ras me bzhi hastā/ gro bzhin/ ji a bhi dzi ta/ bzhin/ /'di bzhin khur bzhes dpang tshe bzhi/ /bzhi swā k+ṣa/ smra rgyan na gas 'phul mdzad don dag ma dag gi ming yin/ mnyam bzhag nang khrol bzhag kyang / 'dab chags bzhad dang / sogs bas 'phul zha'o// ༈ //za tshod mi zad bla skyal zer/ gzhan la zlo/ /sngags zlos zlos nrā ṭa ka gar zla tsan+d+ra/ ba zlum/ bṛt+ta/ /zla ar+dha tsan+d+ra/ gam zlas dwanadwa/ dbye zlog ni bā ra ṇa/ pa dang / /zla sa khā/ grogs lo zlar mya ngan zlo/ /bskyar ba'i zlos sogs mtha' 'gogs pa'am thag gcod pa'i la zlo ba/ za nyid do/
