/gcan gzan sho pa/ gzig gi gzugs pra ti bim+bi/ brnyan gzigs/ a ba lo ki ta/ /gza' skar gra ha/ 'od rash+mi/ zer gzi te dza/ brjid gzi/ dro ha ri/ nor bu/ /rngul gzan phrag par gzing cing gzar/ saṃ gaṃ gṛ twā/ /gzong ṭaṃ ka gi gzeb ma gur/ pañdza ra/ gzer kī la/ bu gzugs/ /gzegs ma gzeg ka ṇā da/ zan gzir bas gzab/ rdeg par brtsams pa/ /da gzod drin gzo chud mi gzon/ /gzu bab col lam rang bzo/ brtun ngas pa'ang zer don la ma brtags pa'o/ /sa ha sa/ lum gzugs grā he/ 'dzin gzeg cha chung / /zug gzer la gzem 'dzems pa/ gzims sup+ta/ mal gzud/ /gze ma tsher ma gzang ring gzan/ /spyan gzigs sha gzugs zas kyi gzan/ /phying gzar gzar phrin gzar sogs/ gzar ka dru/ bu dgang gzar/ prā trī/ blugs shru ba kaṃ gzar/ /gzengs ut+te dza na/ bstod gzi o dzo/ mdangs gzod ā ti/ gdod ma ste dang po/ ma'i dus/ /ri gzar gzugs mo srog chags/ byi thur gyi/ gzugs/ rū pya/ /gzar gos kyi gdang bu/ thag gzungs dra bo drub po gzungs btab po lta bu/ btag gzabs bzabs kyang 'thad/ kyang gzags/ zags pa/ /gzung spobs gzungs dhā ra ṇi/ sngags thugs gzu bo/ /sgo ba rnar bslab bya la mi nyan pa'i don te 'dul ba'i brda/ gzon gas 'phul za'o/ /bza' bho dza na/ ba bza' bzas bhuk+ta/ bud med bza'/ rgya mo bza'/ bal mo bza' lta bu dang / bza' shing ra ba sogs kyang ngo / /bza' mi bzi mat+ta/ zhing ma bzlugs ma dris kyang / kyang / /na bza' bzang bha dra/ po lag pas bzung / gṛ hī ta/ /bzo shilpa/ bos lhung pā tra/ slong phor zer/ bzed bzed zhal bzed/ /bze chung mi ka rā la/

gtum pa dang drag po drag shul mi sdug pa/ zad las la bzur/ /bzod k+ṣān+ti/ pa tshogs piṇ+ḍa yi twā/ bzlums sngags bzla dza ba/ bzlas/ badza pi ta/ thon pa'ang zer/ /mi mi slon zer/ a ni bār+ya/ bzlog g.yul bzlog mya ngan bzla/ /gcig tu bsdus pa/ bzlums sogs bas thag bcad pa'i don la bzlas zhes pa sogs kyang / 'phul za'o/ /yi rang yi chad yi dwags dang / /mda' yab rnga yab ya rkyang ngo / /g.yor gru'i dar po che/ mo g.yo tsa la/ g.yos g.yab mo g.yabs/ /g.yar gdong dang / bcol ba'i ngo / gzhan yang spyin 'dren la g.yar 'dren/ khas len pa la g.yar len/ dam bca' la g.yar dam/ mdun la g.yar lam/ sku khams la g.yar khams sogs kyang ngo / /ngo tsha la g.yar tsha'o/ /ngo g.yar kha khral/ khral g.yan pa dgab/ /g.yang pra pā/ sa mi a tsa la/ g.yo g.yung shā shwa ta/ drung g.yang / /g.yel med gzur 'bras bu 'phyang ba/ /za zas g.yo g.yos/ /g.yang gzhi g.yog g.yogs g.yer mas g.yig /g.yi lpags g.yar brnyas pa dang brnyan pa'ang zer/ /nas g.yab g.yug g.yob/ /g.yon ma log mi th+yā tsar+ya/ g.yem 'dod pa/ g.yeng bik+ṣe pa/ bas g.yengs/ rnam g.yeng gi don phyar g.yeng kyang ngo / /de rang nyid kyi 'dod pa'i chos gzhan la ngom zhing sgeg chos kyi don yin par gsungs/ /g.ya' byang bu/ sgog skyi g.ya' lcags g.ya' g.yu/ pe ro tsa/ /g.yung mo ṭom+pi nī/ rigs ngan pa'i/ g.yo sgyu sha ṭha/ g.yer bag snang yal can/ tsa ma ra/ g.yag dud 'gro /g.yas dak+ṣi ṇa/ g.yon bā ma/ g.yul ā yu dha/ sprod g.yul 'bru yi g.yul/ las g.yog pa ri bā ra/ /mig g.yor kha g.yal g.yar ngo tsha/ /g.yar chab snang g.yel g.yer ka sogs/ /ga mi brtson g.yel sogs/ ā la sa/ yis 'phul ba'i ya khams pa grims pa'i brda g.yer po che dang zhan pa'i don g.yung ba'o/

/nyid do// ༈ //ra a dza/ lug e ṭa/ rwa shriṅga / co rdul du rlog /a bhi mngon rlom mā na/ rlom sems ma n+ya/ byin adhiṣ+ṭhā na/ rlabs rlobs/ /rlon pa rlag byed 'doms kyi rlig /rlabs ma harmi/ chen dba' urmi/ rlabs rlangs bā sh+pa/ pa rlung / bā yu/ rdzi dang skyi ser/ /rlam ham khyer/ khyer khrag rlangs rlan rlon aradra/ chang / /rlag mo rlags pa khung bu'i rlungs/ /dud 'gro'i rlid bu bas 'phul med/ zas ma zhu bar 'og tu don pa'i ming rlugs pa'ang yin par smra rgyan las bshad/ /bcom yul khang sogs/ brlag tshig brlang tshig rtsub/ pā ru ṣ+ya/ brlag bya brlags/ /brla sha lus kyi/ shak+ti/ chus brlan aradra/ ya ma brla/ snying po med pa/ /blo grogs la/ brlug brtan brling sgrub pa'am bab thob yod pa blo la yod pa sha chags pa sogs la 'jug par bshad/ byin gyis brlabs/ a dhiṣ+ṭhi ta/ /gdon gyis bskyod pa/ brlams sogs bas gu ru/ dul ba'i brling kyang ngo / /smra rgyan las gzhan skyon brlong pa'ang 'di yin par bshad/ 'phul rla'o/ /lwa la ba ni snam bu dkar po la 'jug pa'o/ /de la klab pa'ang zer bar bshad 'dug go /ni gos kyi bye brag ming / /lhun me ru/ po lho phyogs dak+ṣi ṇa/ lha rje lha/ dā+e wa/ /lhan ne ta pa ti/ lham me lhang nge lhag /sār+dham̐/ /lhan cig lhun ni rā bho ga grub lhang tsher lham/ /lhag a dhi/ par lhag ma she ṣa/ la btags so// ༈ //shar pūrba/ gyi shing bh+rik+ṣa/ khar shang dzī ba dzībika shang shi mṛ ta/ /shul du shi ro sman nam/ gshin zas sam/ dad zas la'ang / gshin po la dmigs pa'i dge ba bsgrub pa/ zan shel s+pha ṭi ga gyi shubs/ /shed ma nu/ bu shed bdag shed las ma nu dza/

skyes/ /shun tsarma/ lpags sham thabs ni ba sa na/ shur paṭ+ṭi kā/ bus bcings/ /shes prañdza bān/ ldan shin tu shub bur smra/ /shen pa shwa 'od sha rdzun gyi don sho ba dang / shob kyang ngo / /rkyang ngo / /bde bshegs gshis lugs de bzhin ta thā ga ta/ gshegs/ /gshin mṛ ta/ po'i gshag byed gshin ya ma/ rje'i gshed/ a ri/ /gshen rabs gshang dkrol dbu skra rtsub pa'i don zer ba snang yang / gtsubs pa'i don zer rgyu yin nam snyam/ gshor/ /gshis ngan g.yul gshom gshung shub bur smod pa/ dang gshe kha 'thab/ /mo gsham a ban+dha/ gsha' ma yin du gsha'/ /gshor thod pa'i ming la'ang gshor du bshad/ gyi chu gsho shing gshog gshags/ bin+na/ /thong ha la/ gshol gsheg cing 'dab gshog pak+ṣa/ gshibs/ /brlan gsher aradra/ bres gshor phrang la gshor/ /gsham gyi spang gshongs sā nu/ zhing sa gshin/ mnyes gshin pa/ /gshongs bu la sogs gas 'phul sha'o/ /mdza' bshes mi tra/ dge bshes lha bshos zhal zas dang zhal tshus kyang zer/ g.yos pa la bshos dang / g.yo ba la bsho ba zhes pa'i tha snyad kyang za ma tog las gsungs so/ /nai bi d+ya/ bshams/ /sdig bshags de sha na/ phyi gshol bshul lam marga/ bshar/ /bshum logs la/ bshum bshal lag pas/ drud bshud dum bur/ nas bshegs/ /bsha' tshe'i bgo sha ri dwags bshar/ /rgya bshul pags bshus bshan shen pa'ang zer/ pas bshas/ /mer bshur chus bshal pra k+ṣā la/ bshang biṭa/ slad tsha'ang zer/ ba bsho /mkhar bshig nā shi ta/ bres bshar 'phrang la bshar/ /bsher dang bshad pa bhā ṣa ṇa/ bas 'phul sha'o// ༈ //sangs rgyas bud+dha/ sor mo aṅgu li/ sen mo na la/ so/ dan+da/ /sil snyan bā d+ya/ sil sil kiṅki ni/ se mo do/ ar+dha hā ra/ /tshe srog prā ṇa srungs shig 'od kā sh+ya pa/

srung srab/ /srid bha ba/ par drang ṛ ṣi/ srong srol tshugs srid/ /srod sa yaṃ/ dus sa sros sre nag srab/ ta nu/ /srin rā k+ṣa sa/ po lus ka ṭa pū ra ṇa/ srul sa srung glang chen/ bu/ /srub kyi lam srang ba la/ 'jal byed srang yang / tu la/ srid du srings/ /yid man+mā tha/ 'dod chags/ srubs kyis sregs da ha na/ sring mor sred/ /sro ma'i srid zhu sri'u'i sri/ /sre mo sre mo srog chags/ sreg pa ti ti ri/ srin bya sram/ o dra/ /srin bu sro ma srad bu sra/ swā ra/ /ji srid de srid sran ma srus/ /bsnyen sring nye ring / sbyin sreg sreg blugs dang / /rgyal srid yun srings rta yi srab/ /srub shing srub thag 'jal byed srang / 'jal byed srang yang / /slob dpon slob ma slob gnyer sla/ /slob pa slo snod yin/ slo 'bo yin pa 'dra/ mar slong mo slong / /sle ba gyen yan mgo skyon can/ slong slog kyang sleb/ /sle 'di zhang zhung gi skad yin par bshad/ gzhan bod skad la ta la ra btags med gsungs/ tres slu gu'i chu sla mdo/ /kun slong sla sems gya gyu can/ yon bsad pa'i slo/ dur 'gro'i/ /slar a bhi/ zhing slar yang slu med slad/ /le'u slog slag pa zhes pa'ang snang / don la pags slog yin/ pa phyi nang slog /sla nga'i slad phyi rol/ rol phyogs su slon/ lan slon sogs kyang ngo / /de la lan lon yang zer/ /slad mar slad nas dug ro slong / /sra brkyang chos gos stan la 'ding ba zhig gi bting sogs sa nye du'i sru mo sogs kyang ngo / /kha dog 'dres pa'i sre mong ngo / /btsun mo'i 'khor gyi don slas dang / sgrib pa dang mtshan mo dang / grib ri sogs la 'jug pa'i sribs kyang ngo / /nyid do// ༈ //gsar na bi ka bu gsar nas mkhar khak+khi ri/

gseg shang dang / gsil byed kyang zer/ gsil gsor/ /kha gsags gsog gsob gsad bya gsod/ ghā ta ka gsang man+t+ra/ sngags snyan gsan 'bebs pa/ gsung rab pra ba tsa na/ gsung / bā dī/ /gsong po'i pūrba bā dī/ sngar smras pa'am drang por smra ba/ tshig gsol gsol a dh+ye ṣa ṇa/ 'phe'u yang zer/ 'debs gsol/ /gser mdog ne'u gsing ha ri ta sādha la/ gseg ma'i gseb/ /gseb rta/ dang gsa' srog chags/ yis gsag gsir te/ /shing gsom gsor gyis gsil zhing gses/ /gsas mo gsog san+ni dhi/ 'jog gsang gtam gsong / go pa ṇa/ gso ra gos gos ma sogs/ ras spu gsed gseng gi gsur/ /gsus pa gso phyir gsol yang gsur/ sgreg pa/ /so gsod lus gsig gsigs dang gsungs sogs kyang ngo / /dril gsil gsum/ tri/ /skad gsang gseg shang gseg ka li/ /gson po snyan shṛ ṇu/ gson chud ma gson/ /'od pra bhā swa ra/ gsal nang gses dri chu gsil/ /gsal zhing chud gsan gas 'phul sa'o/ /sngo bsangs 'bags bsangs brtsangs pa'ang zer/ tshogs bsags bsag /dmigs bsal a pa bā dha/ skyon bsal bsam bya dh+yā ya/ bsams/ /bse khrab bsod nams pu ṇ+ya/ bsod snyoms sogs/ /tshe bsrings bsam blo saṃ kalpa/ drin bsab bsabs/ /yo bsrang nor bsri rgyang bsring bsrings/ /dri gar+bha/ bsung gis bsus bse ru khaḍ+ga/ bsad/ mā ri ta/ bsrung bya bsrung ba bsreg bya bsreg bzod bsran bsro zhes pa khrus bku mnye dril phyi mo snyan rnams kyi ming / gang zhong bsrubs bsres/ /bsod praṇī ta/ zas bzang po/ pa'i zas bsrel 'chang ba/ ring bsrel dhā tu/ bsrings/ /bya ba'i bsral mi blo 'dral can zhes pa lta bu/ dang sgrib pa bsrab/ /bsel 'jigs skyabs kyi skyel ma/ ba'i bso sgra ngal bsos bu/

/kha bsum rjes bsubs bser bu bsil/ /lha bsangs me bsangs skyo bsang dang / /blo bsrun bsam se'u sba bsri med/ /bsang gtor zhabs bsil zhal bsil bsro/ /bslad bya bslad nas bslu bya bslus/ /bslang bya'i nor bslangs phyogs su bslan/ bsdus pa'am phyogs gtogs su 'then pa/ /bslab bya bslabs pa gyen du bslang / /'dod pa'i bsod su kha l+li kā/ 'dod pa la lhag par longs spyod pa'i ming yin/ zas kyi bsod snyoms dang mi lung pa gtso bor bzung ngo / nyams bas 'phul sa'o// ༈ //hral hral hrul hrul mig hrig hrig /hwa shang rgya nag gi skad btsun pa/ hwags bu ram gyi kha bun bzang shas kyi ming de la gal la'ang zer/ dang gos kyi hwa/ /rtsal smra rgyan las rtsab hral zhes snang / hral hrud rtsub/ hrud ha nyid do/ /a ka ru dang a ru ra/ /u dum+ba me tog dmar mchog ra ut+pa la/ /o rgyan au ḍi ya ṇa 'phur 'gro ste zur chag u ma an+da rnyil/ in+d+ra ni la dbang po sngon po ste zur 'chag /shing tog a mra e la'i 'dab/ /e ṇ+ya ya na a nyid do/ /bod kyi brda'i bstan bcos mkhas mang dgongs pa'i bcud bsdus gsung rab kun la lta ba'i legs bshad mig dbang rab gsal snang ba zhes bya ba las sngon 'jug sogs yi ge'i sbyor ba rgyas par bshad pa'i sarka ste dang po'o/ /gnyis pa rnam dbye 'phrad sogs gces pa sna tshogs thun mong du bshad pa ni/ da ni rnam dbye phrad la sogs/ /gces bsdus sil bur bstan pa las/ /thog mar rnam dbye drug pa yi/ /kyi gi gyi 'i yi rnams ni/ /da ba sa dang da drag dag /thob mthar kyi dang ga nga gi /na ma ra la bzhi po gyi/ /mtha' rten med mthar 'i thob cing / /rkang pa skong bdun bsgrigs lta bu'i/ tshe yi thob dper/ /khyod kyi rgyab kyi g.yas kyi char/ /gyurd kyi brag gi byang gi phyogs/ /dpon gyi lam gyi bar gyi sar/

/zhol gyi sa gzhi'i bdag de yi/ zhes pa lta bu'o/ /'o bo gnyis kyi tsheg khyim yang / /rkang pa skong mi skong gis dbye/ /bde'o la sogs rdzogs tshig la/ /'o nyid spyi bo la sogs pa'i/ /ming la ba phyed ba nyid do/ /mtha' rten can dang brtsegs pa dang / /gug kyed can mthar 'a mtha' spang / /tshig phrad ga da ba'i rjes su/ /cing ces ce bo ce na cig /nga na ma 'a ra la dang / /mtha' rten med pa'i rjes dag tu/ / skad cig kha cig dmigs bsal/ zhing zhes zhe bo zhe na zhig /sa mthar shing she bo she sa mthar shes thob kyang de mi mdzes pas zhes zer ba dmigs bsal yin te blo ldan shes rab dang / dpang los kyang shes zer ba bkag par gsungs pas so/ /na shig /na ra la gsum rjes su ni/ /da drag thob 'di la za ma tog las/ rkyang par dang gug kyed can gyi mthar 'o dgos par gsungs shing / 'dogs can gyi mthar bo dang lo 'di 'dri ba 'thad kyi gsal kha mi 'byung bas 'dir bkod pa ni smra rgyan dang ngag sgron bzhin bris pa yin no/ /phyir de gsum gyi/ /rjes su zhing sogs lnga thob kyang / /da drag nges par thob pa la/ /cing sogs lnga po thob pa'i dper/ /rtag cing rtog ces rtag ce bo/ /su 'dug ce na khyod 'dug cig /rgud cing zad ces med ce bo/ /ci 'chad ce na chos shod cig /zab cing thob ces nub ce bo/ /gang rgyab ce na gri rgyob cig /byang zhing drang zhes 'byung zhe'o/ /da bzung zhe na sems bzung zhig /snyan zhing 'jen zhes dkon zhe bo/ /lha yin zhe na don zhig gnyer/ /'jam zhing ngom zhes 'jom zhe 'o/ /dben nam zhe na nam zhig dben /dga' zhing bza' zhes dka' zhe 'o/ /du gda' zhe na 'ga' zhig go /dar zhing 'phyur zhes 'gyur zhe'o/ /ci 'phyar zhe na dar phyor zhig /'chol zhing 'chal zhes 'khrul zhe'o/ /gang 'chol zhe na chos chol zhig /za zhing bde zhes spro zhe'o/ /e smra zhe na ma smra zhig

/'dus shing 'bral bar nges she'o/ /cis nges she na gtam smros shig /mkhyen cing phrald ces brgyan ce'o/ /cis grold ce na grol gyurd cig /dri dang rdzogs tshigs skabs su ni/ /mtha' rten med dang sa mthar 'a/ /mtha' rten gzhan mthar rang rang la'o/ /da drag can mthar ta ste dper/ /bde'am bde'o dga' 'am dga' 'o/ /gyurd tam gyurd to na ra gnyis la rang sbyor dang / gzhan sbyor rnam pa gnyis su 'gyur te/ dper na/ bzhin no zhes ni ngas bstan to/ /ngo mtshar ro zhes gzhan 'dzer to/ /zhes za ma tog tu gsungs pa da drag thob/ mi thob kyi khyad par ro/ /lta bu'o/ /lhag ma can gyi te ste de/ /na ra la sa da drag gi /rjes su te rkyang da mthar de/ /ga nga ba ma 'a 'di ni/ /mtha' rten med mthar sa ste dper/ /byon te skor te nor btsal te/ /skyangs te gyur te don med de/ /rtag ste gtsang ste lhun grub ste/ /'jam ste dga' ste sems bde ste/ zhes pa lta bu'o/ /rnam dbye bdun pa la don gyi/ /tu du ru su'i zhabs kyu ni/ /ga ba da drag can mthar tu/ /nga da na ma ra la du/ /sa su mtha' rten med pa dang / /'a mthar ru ste dpe rim bzhin/ /rtag tu rab tu shin tu dang / /steng du snod du rgyun du zo/ /lam du myur du mjal du song / /rjes su 'di ru dga' sdug chug ces pa lta bu'o/ /mtshams sbyor kyang 'ang yang rnams ni/ /ga da ba sa nyid dang ni/ /da drag thob pa'i rjes su kyang / /nga na ma 'a ra la yang / /mtha' rten med mthar 'ang dang ni/ /rkang pa skong tshe yang ste dper/ na/ /bdag kyang bsad kyang don grub kyang / /byas kyang 'ond kyang ma byung yang / /byon yang nam yang 'ga' yang ni/ /slar yang mjal yang blo'ang bde yang / zhes pa lta bu'o/ /ming mtha'i pa ba'i dbye ba ni/ /ga da na ba ma sa dang / /da drag can mthar pa dang ni/ /nga 'a ra la mtha' rten/ med mtha'i/ /ba phyed war 'phod rnams la ba/

/gzhan la pa nyid sbyar te dper/ /zag pa med pa phan pa mchog /thob pa dam pa mkhas pa ru/ /gyurd pa dang ba la dga' ba/ /myur bar mjal bar spro ba las/ /lung ba mda' pa'i 'byor pa yis/ /yul pa phu pa tshim sogs zhib mor/ dpyad/ nas 'di rnams skabs thob shes pa gal che'o/ /gcod mtshams mtha' rten ba yi mthar/ /chig shad nga yig ma gtogs pa'i/ /shad gong rnams rnams su phyi tsheg spang / /don mang bgrangs pa'i ming gi ni/ /mtshams dang sa dang / chu dang / me dang zhes pa lta bu/ don 'bring sdug bsngal bden pa dang / kun 'byung bden pa dang zhes pa lta bu/ 'byed pa dang / /don nyung rdzogs mtshams za sha'o/ /nga'o lta bu/ chig shad dang / /tshigs su bcad pa'i rkang mtha' dang / /lhug pa'i sde tshan rdzogs mtshams kyi/ /sna na ro'i brda rnying / ru can mthar nyis shad bya/ /sde tshan chen po rdzogs mtshams dang / /le'u mtshams lta bur bzhi shad thob/ /bod kyi brda'i bstan bcos mkhas mang dgongs pa'i bcud bsdus gsung rab kun la lta ba'i legs bshad mig dbang rab gsal snang ba zhes bya ba las rnam dbye phrad la sogs gces pa sna tshogs thun mong du bshad pa'i sarka ste gnyis pa'o// ༈ //gsum pa yi ge'i sbyor ba la 'khrul pa spong pa bshad pa ni/ /da ni 'phul dang mtha' rten mgo /med la sbyor dang yod la spong / /'dam dag par byas na gdam nga zer ba yin kyang go sla ba'i phyir 'di ltar bkod pa'o/ /smra rgyan du bdam nga zer ba snang / ka can la mtha' gcig tu/ /'dzin pa'i 'khrul spong cung zad bshad/ /rnga yab ge sar sil snyan dang / /mngon sum phun sum tshogs sogs la/ /gas 'phul nor ro gsha' ma dang / /gshags 'byed sogs la med na nor/ /sar pa gas 'phul yod med gnyis ka 'thad/ /lta bur gang yang rung / /skyil 'di la smra rgyan du das 'phul bshad kyang / krung sogs la das de ltar mi mdzad pa 'di ni zha lu lo chen gyi dgongs pa dpyis phyin pa'o/

/'phul med/ /dgung lo mtshan dgung long khrid kyi/ /dmigs bu sogs la med das 'phul/ na nor/ /snyan ngag sogs la dngags kyang / gang yang rung / /phyag dar phyags snyigs/ lag rang gis/ dar gad mo dang / /skra so mang sogs/ shad sogs la bas 'phul spang / /bser bu skyo bsangs rgya mo bza'/ /phyi bdar sogs la bas 'phul/ med na nor/ /sngo bsangs lta bur gang bas 'phul yod med/ yang rung / /tha gru tha ma tshar du dngar/ /tshon rtsi sogs la mas 'phul spang / /mthe bo mtshe lhan cig tu skyes pa/ ma sngo sman mtshe/ /khyim mtshes sogs la mas 'phul/ med na nor/ /thun mong sogs la yod med/ gang yang rung / /tshong dus khams dang tshogs pa tshoms/ /phra ma 'khon 'dzin khro ba khros/ /rim gro phra mo phongs pa dang / /phyug po sogs la 'as 'phul spang / /mtha' 'khob 'khri shing 'khur ba dang / /tshul 'chos sogs la med 'as 'phul/ na nor/ /'phrin las phreng sogs gang 'as 'phul yod med/ yang rung / /yi ge myu gu lu gu rgyud/ /shākya sogs la ga mtha' spang / /phrag dog phrug gur sogs la ga mtha'/ /med na nor/ /pus mo'i lha nga sla nga dang / /sgo nga sogs la nga mtha' nor/ /yi dam yi rang yi dwags dang / /sri zhu sogs la da mtha' nor/ /skad cig lta bur da mtha' yod med/ gang yang rung / /se mo do la na mtha' spang / /byan mo lta bu med na mtha'/ na nor/ /lha btsun bza' btung gdu bu dang / /le brgan sogs la ba mtha' nor/ /rgya 'dre kha mchu ra mda' dang / /ra nye na bza' rtswa mchog grong / /rgya mtsho sogs la ma mtha' nor/ /lha rje mdo rgyud nga rgyal can/ /bya rgod rdo rdor dril zhes pa lta bu'i sgra bsdu ba'i tshe ra mdzad pa ni dmigs bsal lo/ /rje mtha' rten dang / /lha rten sogs la ra mtha' med/ /dur khrod mdor bsdus la sogs/ ra mtha'/ med na/

nor/ /bde gshegs sogs la gang bde bar gshegs pa'i sgra bsdus pa'am/ yang na bu kha ta zhes bde ba dang / gshegs pa'i tshig gnyis las med pas ra mtha' yod med gnyis/ yang rung / /snyun gyi gsos sman kha dro dang / /grwa lnga sogs la la mtha' nor/ /rig sngags gsung rab mkhyen rab dang / /na 'phang go 'phang khri 'phang mchog /bskyed rim rdzogs rim 'du shes dang / /mkha' spyod sa skyod do shal phreng / /nyam chung nyam thag nyam nga ba/ /log rtog som nyi chom rkun dang / /so ga sogs la sa mtha' nor/ /lhas byin smra rgyan las lha sbyin mi sbyin zer na sa mtha' mi dgos par gsungs/ klus byin gdams ngag sogs/ /mang po zhig la med sa mtha'/ na nor/ /dri bzangs rgyud mang go rim dang / /'khor los 'khor lo bskor ba dang skad dod gcig pas sa mtha' med kyang rung la/ phur bus thob sogs kyi rigs pas sa mtha' yod kyang mi 'gal/ bsgyur sogs gang yang rung / /klad kor stod kor gdub kor dang / /pad kor than kor 'od kor phreng / /a mra sogs la sa mgo nor/ /ngur smrig smig rgyur sa mgo med na nor/ /yi ge byañdza na/ zhal ta da lta dang / /la sogs tha dad ces rnams la/ /bar tsheg mi byed pa/ blun po'i lugs/ te de 'dra ma bshad pa'i phyir/ /de ltar mdo tsam bshad pa 'dis/ /mtshon nas shin tu rgya che'i gnas/ /rang rang rnam dpyod rig pas dpyad/ /mtha' dag yi ger brjod mi lang / /bod kyi brda'i bstan bcos mkhas mang dgongs pa'i bcud bsdus gsung rab kun la lta ba'i legs bshad mig dbang rab gsal snang ba zhes bya ba las yi ge'i sbyor ba la 'khrul pa spong ba bshad pa'i sarka ste gsum pa'o/ /spyi don gsum pa de ltar bshad pa'i dge ba byang chub tu bsngo ba ni/ e ma brda yi bstan bcos ngo mtshar gnas/ /mchog dman tshig gi brjod bya rjod byed kyi/ /ma dag dri ma ma lus sel byed pa'i/

/legs bshad 'di 'dra gang gis smra ste mkhas/ /phyis byon mkhas pas mdzad mtshan dngos ngag dbang chos kyi rgya mtsho dbyangs can snyems pa'i sdes/ gzhan dpal sgang lo tsā bar grags pa/ pa'i bod kyi brda'i/ /bye brag gsal byed ngag gi sgron ma las/ /paṇa chen byams gling dag pa'i/ yig smra ba'i rgyan/ ni/ /tshig mang don nyung zha lu lo chen gyi/ /za ma tog ni tshig don gnyis ka bsdus/ /snar thang lo tsā sogs kyi dag yig 'ga'/ /sum rtags yig rnying sogs dang mi mthun pas/ /des na rang gzhung kho na mchog ces smra/ /'dir ni lo chen chos skyong bzang po yi/ /rtsod bral gsung rab dgongs pa gtsor byas shing / /dpyod ldan mang po'i legs bshad kyis brgyan phyir/ /mkhas mang dgongs pa 'dus pa'i bstan bcos yin/ /'dir sbyar dge bas mtshon pa'i dus gsum du bsags pa'i legs byas kyi mthus/ bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /dus 'dir tshe ring zhing / nad med bsam don 'grub/ pa dang / /phyi ma lhan cig bde ba can du/ skyes nas/ /gnas der sa dang lam rnams myur bgrod de/ /gang 'dul sprul pas mkha' mnyam 'gro ba kun/ /zhing der drangs nas rang gzhan ma lus pa/ /myur du tshogs gnyis mthar phyin 'bras bu'i mchog /rnam mkhyen byang chub thob pa'i rgyur bsngo'o/ /de dag gis ni bod kyi brda'i bstan bcos mkhas mang dgongs pa'i bcud bsdus gsung rab kun la lta ba'i legs bshad mig dbang rab gsal snang ba ma tshang ba med par bstan zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las pa/ /gangs can 'gro ba'i mun sel sam+bho ṭa/ /bstan pa bsdu mdzad sprul pa'i skyes chen de'i/ /bka' drin dran pas slar yang phyag bgyi'o/ /bstan bcos 'di ni gsung rab tshig don kun/ /gsal bar lta ba'i mig gi dbang po ste/ /kha ba ri ba'i skad smra thams cad la/ /dgos 'dod kun 'byung yid bzhin nor dang mtshungs/

/mkhas mchog rnams la snying la 'bab pa yi/ /tshig gi gter te skye dgu ma lus pa'i/ /blo gros yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas byed cing / /tshig sbyor kun la ri bya'i khyor sngon drang srong ri byis rgya mtsho hub gcig gis btung ba ltar/ brda'i bstan bcos 'di mkhas par shes na tshig sbyor kun tshegs med bde blag tu khong du chud pas so/ /chu bzhin/ /de ltar shes pas blo gsal dpyod ldan rnams/ /tshur spyon snyom las ma byed legs bshad 'di/ /ri mor bris la thos bsam gyis sbyangs te/ /rang gzhan mgrin pa mdzes pa'i rgyan du longs/ /ding sang dus 'dir skye bo blun po rnams/ /brda dag tshul 'di lung dang rig pa yi/ /dpyad gzhi chung bas tshegs med shes snyam du/ /rlom pas ji snyam mi sems mgo bo rmongs/ /legs par brtags na shes bya'i yul rnams kyi/ /ming gi rgyu mtshan nges tshig mtha' yas shing / /de dag yi ge'i sbyor ba 'khrul gyur na/ /don rnams 'khrul bar 'gyur bas tshul 'di ni/ /ngag tshig brjod pa tsam gyi dag byed de/ /bka' dang bstan bcos kun gyi phyi mo lags/ /de phyir chos kyi rtsa ba brda'i bstan bcos/ /'di nyid kun gyis 'bad pas len par rigs/ /zhes bod kyi brda'i bstan bcos mkhas mang dgongs pa'i bcud bsdus gsung rab kun la lta ba'i legs bshad mig dbang rab gsal snang ba zhes bya ba 'di'ang / khams gsum gyi bla ma grub thob kyi 'khor lo bsgyur ba 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams dbang po'i zhal snga nas dang / rgyal ba'i yab gcig sbas pa'i sangs rgyas sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros/ dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag drug pa rdo rje sems dpa' nyid gzhan ngor ngur smrig gi bla gos 'chang ba rje btsun mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rnams gtso bor smos pa'i yongs 'dzin chos bzhin spyod pa du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen paṇ+ḍi ta mkhas pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos rgya gar lugs la bā hu dha n+yaḥzhes pa 'bru mang dang /
